jobs.title: Principal Solutions Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

About the Role

We are seeking a Principal Solutions Delivery Manager to act as a senior implementation leader within our Solution Consulting organization. While our Implementation Managers and Solutions Architects guide customers through day-to-day deployments, the Solutions Director steps in as the strategic anchor for our largest, most complex, and highest-stakes enterprise implementations.

In this role, you will be responsible for three core pillars:

  1. Executive Oversight of Complex Deployments: Taking ownership of implementation success for strategic, global, and highly complex customer deployments (multi-entity, multi-ERP integrations, complex change management).

  2. Team Strategy & Process Scalability: Re-architecting and refining our implementation methodologies, governance frameworks, and delivery playbooks to support hyper-growth.

  3. Leadership Development: Mentoring, coaching, and upskilling a team of talented Implementation Managers and Solutions Architects, cultivating the next generation of professional services leaders at Zip.

If you are an experienced consulting or professional services leader who loves combining big-picture strategy with hands-on technical problem-solving, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Our Most Complex Projects: Serve as the Executive Sponsor and senior implementation authority on strategic, Fortune 500, and highly customized enterprise deployments. Partner directly with C-suite executives and key customer stakeholders to navigate organizational complexity, mitigate deployment risk, and ensure time-to-value.

  • Define Implementation Strategy & Playbooks: Evaluate current delivery methodologies and design scalable, repeatable processes for discovery, solution architecture, workflow design, and testing. Drive standardization across the team without sacrificing flexibility.

  • Drive Leadership Development: Act as a player-coach and mentor to Senior Implementation Managers and Solutions Architects. Provide strategic guidance on project governance, stakeholder management, and technical delivery while fostering a high-performance, collaborative team culture.

  • Cross-Functional Executive Alignment: Partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success leadership. Translate complex implementation learnings and customer feedback into actionable product roadmap inputs and pre-sales scoping improvements.

  • Establish Governance & Quality Standards: Implement rigorous project health monitoring, risk escalation frameworks, and quality assurance standards to maintain exceptional customer satisfaction (CSAT) and net revenue retention (NRR).

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior Implementation Experience: 10+ years of experience in enterprise software implementation, professional services, solutions architecture, or management consulting—with at least 4+ years in a senior leadership or director-level capacity at a SaaS or B2B enterprise technology company.

  • Proven Enterprise Mastery: Demonstrated success overseeing complex, multi-workstream deployments for large-scale enterprises (e.g., integrations with major ERPs like Workday, NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle; global rollouts; complex compliance and security requirements).

  • Strategic Process Builder: A track record of scaling professional services or implementation teams from startup/mid-market to enterprise maturity by designing robust methodologies, playbooks, and KPIs.

  • Passionate People Leader: Exceptional focus on mentorship and leadership development. You take pride in coaching individual contributors into top-tier strategic advisors and future team managers.

  • Executive Presence: Outstanding communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills. Comfortable challenging assumptions, managing scope creep, and guiding C-level customer stakeholders through transformative change.

  • Domain Expertise: Familiarity with procurement, finance, accounting, accounts payable (AP automation), or supply chain workflows is a strong plus.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • High Impact: You will play a defining role in shaping how Zip delivers value to our largest customers, directly influencing our growth and operational maturity.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work alongside a world-class team of builders, problem-solvers, and industry experts who are passionate about customer success.

  • Competitive Compensation: Top-tier salary, generous equity packages, and comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.

  • Flexibility: Work in an environment that values autonomy, ownership, and results over micromanagement.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Private health, vision & dental coverage

  • 🚍 Commuter benefit

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget

  • 💸 Pension Contribution

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Product Manager PRINCE2
jobs.description:
Are you interested in working with a leading education technology player, the global leader in the assessment and certification of professional skills industry with presence in more than 200 countries worldwide? If so, this is the chance to apply now! 📥

Shape the future of PRINCE2. The home of modern projects, programme, and portfolio management.

PeopleCert is looking for a Product Manager to help take our PRINCE2 portfolio of Best Practice to the next level of success - developing compelling propositions for globally recognised PRINCE2 products that ensure wide adoption among senior audiences, new sectors and markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of key products in the PRINCE2 portfolio – including certifications, official publications and learning materials – making sure they remain high quality, relevant and well supported in market.

As Product Manager for the PRINCE2 portfolio, you will work closely with teams across the business in order to support delivery of the overall roadmap and enable commercial success for your product set within the PRINCE2 portfolio.

As Product Manager PRINCE2 your tasks will be the following:

Product strategy and vision

  • Contribute to the product vision and strategy, and develop and maintain the roadmap for your product set.
  • Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape that will inform the product strategy.
  • Track agreed product goals and KPIs, and recommend actions to improve performance.

Product management

  • Monitor and analyze product performance, making data-driven recommendations to optimize and enhance your products.
  • Prioritise maintenance and improvement activities for your in-market products, to ensure continued relevance and positive customer experience.

New product development

  • Work proactively and collaboratively with teams across the business to ensure all aspects of product development, launch and in-market support are considered early in the business case and product design phase
  • Support the successful development and launch of new or updated products
  • Participate in all aspects of Product design, including: persona development; full end-to-end user journeys; service blueprints; key content and technical specifications
  • Design and manage the testing strategy for all products in development, to ensure they are consistently meeting the needs of our target audiences

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Contribute key elements to the go-to-market plans developed by Marketing, including positioning, key messaging and more.
  • Contribute to pricing proposals for your product set by providing market, competitor and partner insight, and supporting the relevant internal teams in pricing decisions.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders to secure buy-in and understanding of the product vision.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Product Manager or Product Owner role in one of the following sectors: education, training, professional qualifications (e.g. ACA / CIPD etc.)
  • Knowledge of PeopleCert best practices and ideally familiar with PRINCE2 or other similar PPM (project, programme and portfolio) certification products.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple products and delivering successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrable experience of managing products through their whole lifecycle
  • Familiarity with all elements of product development, from discovery to delivery
  • Proven ability to evaluate product feedback objectively, and propose solutions to address business needs
  • Strong business/commercial acumen
  • Excellent people and management skills to interact with colleagues, cross-functional teams, and third parties around the world
  • Problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Prior exposure in Education, Consulting, Examination/Certification, or Technology sectors will be considered an asset.
  • Excellent command of the English language (C2 level certification desired; LanguageCert C2 LTE or C2 IESOL a plus).
  • Advanced computer literacy required; ECDL Advanced certification desirable. Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or equivalent software will be considered an added advantage.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to shape globally recognized frameworks used by professionals around the world.
  • A collaborative, high-impact international team and a purpose-driven working culture.
  • Flexible working conditions (location and hours).
  • Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees
  • Competitive compensation and personal development opportunities.
  • A global network of professionals and subject matter experts.

If you want to become a member of our international, dynamic and agile team that creates world leading software products, then we should certainly like to hear from you!

About PeopleCert

PeopleCert is a global leader in assessment and certification of professional skills, partnering with multi-national organizations and government bodies for the development & delivery of standardized exams. Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state-of-the-art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their life ambitions.

Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity are the core values which guide everything we do.

Our offices in UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to the reflection of the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business.

Working on Home Office (HO) Secure English Language Tests (SELTs)

Any person who is engaged by PeopleCert to work on the SELT service must undergo a Background Check (the results of which must be acceptable to PeopleCert and the HO) prior to commencing their SELT duties. All SELT personnel will be required to complete a declaration (provided by PeopleCert) where the existence of any criminal record and/or bankruptcy must be declared.

If working on the SELT service in the UK, background checks will include:

  • A basic or enhanced Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check
  • Right to Work in the UK check (including nationality, identity and place of residence)
  • HO security check (Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) or Counter Terrorist Check (CTC)
  • Financial background check
  • Employment reference check.
  • If working on the SELT service anywhere in the world (outside of the UK) personnel will undergo background checks that are equivalent to those stated for the UK.

In addition, if personnel are required to speak to SELT candidates they must be appropriately skilled in English language and, where SELT services are provided anywhere in the world (outside of the UK), the official language of the relevant country.

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

jobs.title: Product Lead, Security & Identity
jobs.description:
Product Lead, Security & Identity

 

Location: Bristol or London (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Level: Lead
Team:
Contract: Permanent
Reporting To: Director - Platform & Security

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

  • You will own the product roadmap for Security & Identity, working with the Head of Security to shape and deliver it by setting outcomes, prioritising across the four teams and reporting progress to leadership.

  • You will be the voice of the client and the engineering community in security decisions, and the person who turns security from a set of controls into a product people want to use.
    Work closely with the Head of Security to shape and deliver our Security & Identity strategy for Kaluza.

  • Ensure security enables velocity and client value while protecting data: shifting security left delivery cycle.

  • Embed a secure-by-default ethos across the organisation, finding ways to make being secure the easiest option.

  • Work closely with our Forward Deployed Engineering teams and directly with clients to understand their identity needs and integrate their systems with ours.

  • Lead the cyber product response to AI: embed the responsible use of AI across our Security and identity capability, including non-human identity, agent authorisation and guardrails for AI tooling.

  • Embed requirements from across our compliance obligations including ISO, client, regulatory, standards, policy into our roadmap, helping ensure we maintain our compliance.

  • Contribute to the client-facing security story: security assurance for RFPs and client reviews, and reporting on security posture to clients and the board.

  • Contribute to the tooling and vendor strategy for security and identity (identity provider, authorisation, detection and response tooling), making the investment case into the technology budget.

  • Partner with Platform Foundations so that security-by-design and data residency requirements are built into the platform, not bolted on.

  • Develop and foster a culture of innovation, operational excellence and continuous improvement across Security & Identity


What you’ll bring

  • Deep experience in either cyber security or identity and access management.

  • Strong product craft: a proven ability to set outcomes and deliver against them.

  • Demonstrable experience working with counterparts in engineering and security to develop and execute a multi-year strategy and roadmap.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tooling and ways of working to deliver outcomes, and a strong builder mentality.

  • Customer obsessed but outcome focused: experience finding novel solutions to client problems rather than defaulting to process.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills: comfortable with senior leadership, and experienced in presenting strategy, outcomes, risk and investment cases to get buy-in and support.


Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience working across multiple global regions, with an understanding of implementing complex regulatory frameworks globally.

  • Experience in regulated or data-sovereignty-sensitive markets (energy, utilities, financial services), including EU data residency.

  • Experience with security or identity for a B2B SaaS platform that serves external clients, including federation with client identity providers.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

Ce que tu apportes

Nos valeurs

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Aller à l’essentiel dans la complexité pour viser des résultats concrets.

Nos avantages

As the Customer Care Product Manager, you are accountable for the outcomes delivered by your product. You will ensure design and engineering teams have absolute clarity on priorities and scope to drive meaningful results for end users and commercial value.

You are the right person for us if you:

  • Have significant product leadership experience in enterprise SaaS and have worked in agile product organisations.

  • Possess deep knowledge of contact centre operations and agent workflows.

  • Have experience working with French enterprise clients and a strong understanding of localisation requirements, including language and regulation.

  • Are skilled at stakeholder management at the executive level, with the ability to manage trade-offs between speed and long-term value.

  • Are data-oriented, with an adeptness for using operational metrics to assess product performance and drive continuous improvement.

  • Have a background in energy retail or utilities (this will set you apart!).

  • Are excited by AI-driven automation, including voice bots and agent assist technology.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Software
jobs.description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

We are scaling fast, and our software work now carries real customer commitments: releases tied to milestones, integration with hardware we don't always own, and demos that have to work the first time. We need a Program Manager who can run a software-heavy defense program with the rigor of a hardware program and the speed of a software team.

You will join our Program Management Office, reporting to the Director of PMO, and own cost, schedule, scope, and risk for a software-centric program. You will sit with engineering leads, product, and our forward deployed engineers, and you will be the person who can tell a customer exactly what ships, when, and what it took to get there.

What you'll do

  • Own the program plan and integrated schedule, tying sprint and release plans to contract milestones, demos, and customer events

  • Translate customer requirements into a prioritized, traceable backlog with engineering and product, and manage scope changes against cost and schedule

  • Run the program cadence: release planning, weekly program reviews, risk and issue boards, and monthly status to leadership and customers

  • Manage program budget and burn, including labor across multiple engineering teams, and flag variance early with a recovery plan

  • Coordinate software integration with aircraft, partner hardware, and government systems, including test events, field exercises, and demonstrations

  • Drive software delivery and accreditation work with our DevSecOps team: deliverable packages, documentation, and cyber and ATO requirements where they apply

  • Lead customer-facing milestone reviews and own contract deliverables (CDRLs, status reports, technical data)

  • Partner with the Director of PMO to build program practices that fit how software teams actually work, without adding bureaucracy

What you bring

  • 6+ years of program or technical program management, with at least 3 years owning software or software-intensive programs for DoD or other government customers

  • Fluency in agile delivery (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe or similar) and experience mapping it to milestone-based defense contracts

  • Enough technical depth to follow architecture discussions, challenge estimates, and spot integration risk early; a software engineering background is a strong plus

  • Experience delivering software that integrates with hardware: autonomy, C2, mission systems, avionics, or similar

  • Hands-on with schedule and backlog tools (Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project or similar) and with budget tracking

  • Comfort leading customer reviews and owning contract deliverables

  • Clear, direct communicator who can brief an engineer and a program officer in the same afternoon

  • U.S. person status as defined by ITAR, and ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

Nice to have

  • Program experience on UAS autonomy, collaborative autonomy, or C2 software

  • Experience with DoD software acquisition pathways, OTAs, or SBIR contracts

  • Exposure to DevSecOps, software factories, or ATO and RMF processes

  • Background at a startup or fast-scaling defense tech company

  • Active Secret clearance or higher

  • PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or DAWIA Program Management certification

Location and details

  • Location: Hybrid, based in Oxnard, CA, with occasional travel to customers, test events, and partner sites

  • Reports to: Director of PMO

  • Compensation: [Add posted base salary range] plus equity and benefits

  • Export control: This role requires access to information subject to ITAR. Candidates must be U.S. persons as defined by 22 CFR 120.62.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.

Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.

We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.

What You'll Do

  • Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
  • Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
  • Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
  • Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
  • Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
  • Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.

Hiring Process

  1. Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
  2. 15-minute phone screen
  3. First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
  4. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS: you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
  • Product craft and taste: you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
  • An AI-native way of working and building: you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
  • You do your own analysis: you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
  • Experience with technical products: you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.
  • Clear writing and comfort working async: we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English.

The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply.

Good to Have

  • Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience.
  • Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises.
  • Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity.
  • Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • You own the adoption metrics: you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it.
  • Lots of room to improve: we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far.
  • Your own engineering team: you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly.
  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Small numbers: we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating.
  • No playbook: this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Insurance)
jobs.description:
At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking an Senior Product Manager specialist to join one of our clients' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in a innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a clear vision and prioritized roadmap for the Claims area and drive product success as a key contributor — from First Notice of Loss (FNOL) through to payout.

  • Shape the automation of the claims process: rule-based and AI-supported claims assessment, straight-through processing, and efficient workflows through to settlement and payout.

  • Drive structured discovery processes and write precise requirements so that, together with Engineering & QA, we can ship quickly and with high quality.

  • Actively integrate AI into your daily work to operate at a higher level, e.g. using structured prompts for rapid prototyping, automated pipelines for user feedback, or data-driven specifications.

  • Communicate priorities clearly to leadership and customers and measure the success of your features based on data, always keeping the user's voice in mind.

  • Design seamless collaboration throughout the claims process for all stakeholders, from status communication and task management to dynamic document templates.


  1. 7+ years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS, InsurTech, or FinTech environment; experience with claims processes or insurance core systems is a strong plus.

  2. Strong operational drive and a clear focus on outcomes: you take real ownership from day one and drive initiatives through to successful implementation.

  3. AI fluency: You can clearly demonstrate how AI has made your work measurably faster or better in recent months (e.g. reusable prompts, AI-supported data analysis, automated workflows).

  4. Solid knowledge of agile frameworks and requirements engineering, as well as confident use of common PM tools such as Jira, Figma, and analytics platforms.

  5. Excellent analytical skills and business-fluent German and English (C1), enabling you to confidently bridge the gap between technology and business.

jobs.title: Delivery Manager - Generation Flex
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Generation Flex
The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU with a focus on Germany.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform, including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

  • Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

  • A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

  • The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

  • A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end, rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

  • Language: professional fluency in German and English

⭐ Bonus points

  • Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

  • Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

  • A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA

  • Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.

  • Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

  • Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

  • Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

  • Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Agent Experience ( Français/ Anglais)
jobs.description:
Product Manager – Agent Experience

Lieu : Paris de préférence, possibilité à Londres (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)
Équipe : Customer Care
Langues : Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais
Contrat : CDI
Rattachement : Lead Product Manager

À noter : ce poste est ouvert à Paris et à Londres, et nécessite un droit de travailler déjà acquis dans le pays où vous serez basé(e) (UE pour Paris, Royaume-Uni pour Londres). Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de parrainage de visa, mais nous étudions le parrainage poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour de futures opportunités.

Merci de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les énergéticiens à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En associant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Piloter la roadmap : porter la stratégie de bout en bout de Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) sur le marché européen, en cohérence avec les objectifs produit globaux et affinée par les besoins clients locaux et les comportements des agents. Vous suivrez les indicateurs opérationnels clés (AHT, FCR, CSAT, adoption de l’IA, onboarding) pour vous assurer que chaque évolution améliore l’expérience des agents et des clients.

  • Concevoir les parcours et garantir la cohérence UX : être le garant de l’expérience agent sur l’ensemble de KAE. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes UX et métier pour appliquer des patterns communs, réduire la charge cognitive des agents et rester aligné avec le design system, y compris quand de nouvelles capacités d’automatisation et d’assistance par l’IA sont introduites.

  • Mener les intégrations et l’onboarding client : piloter les intégrations techniques et produit avec des plateformes tierces, et superviser de bout en bout le déploiement de nouvelles instances KAE pour les nouveaux clients, de la phase de découverte jusqu’à la mise en production.

  • Garantir l’accessibilité et la conformité : défendre les réglementations européennes d’accessibilité dès la conception, en traduisant les exigences réglementaires et spécifiques à chaque marché en besoins techniques concrets.

  • Accompagner les clients et créer de la valeur : être l’expert de confiance des clients sur l’expérience agent, en défendant une configuration native de la plateforme plutôt que des développements sur mesure.

  • Rester les mains dans le cambouis, de la livraison à l’accompagnement : vous impliquer sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie du développement produit (PDLC), des sessions de discovery avec les agents aux boucles de feedback, et produire les supports qui favorisent l’adoption côté clients.

(À noter : des déplacements chez les clients, par exemple à Bruxelles, sont à prévoir, environ 1 à 3 par mois au début, puis 1 à 2 par trimestre.)

Ce que vous apporterez

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Une expertise centres de contact et UX : une solide expérience de la responsabilité de parcours utilisateurs de bout en bout pour des outils opérationnels très sollicités (par exemple des postes de travail d’agents), avec une vraie pratique de la recherche utilisateur, de la cartographie de parcours et des tests d’usabilité auprès d’agents et de superviseurs.

  • Une connaissance de l’accessibilité européenne et de l’intégration de plateformes : une bonne maîtrise des standards d’accessibilité européens, ainsi qu’une expérience avérée d’intégration de produits avec des plateformes tierces et des écosystèmes de fournisseurs complexes.

  • Une expérience de delivery client et d’expansion de marché : un historique de mise en œuvre ou de localisation d’un produit pour des clients entreprise externes, en menant les solutions de zéro à la mise en production : discovery, configuration et conduite du changement.

  • Un jugement fondé sur la donnée et de l’influence : la capacité démontrée à vous appuyer sur des indicateurs opérationnels (AHT, FCR, CSAT, effort de l’agent) pour défendre vos décisions produit, avec un état d’esprit « plateforme d’abord » qui privilégie les capacités existantes au code sur mesure.

  • Un bilinguisme professionnel : une maîtrise complète, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, du français et de l’anglais.

Ce qui fera la différence

jobs.title: Senior Scrum master
jobs.description:
Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken.

AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt.

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert.

Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen,  wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Jouw rol

Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties.

Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven.

Maar je kijkt ook vooruit.

Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen?

Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen. 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid

  • Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering

  • Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie

  • Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders.

  • Meedenken over de inzet van AI-tools om teamprocessen, kennisdeling, delivery en adoptie slimmer te organiseren.

  • Continu verbeteren van flow, kwaliteit en de manier waarop teams waarde leveren.

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Agile-werkwijze binnen een AI First-organisatie.


  • Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Scrum Master binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams in complexe IT-omgevingen.

  • Sterke kennis van Agile, Scrum en teamontwikkeling.

  • PSM I en II, CSM- of vergelijkbare certificering.

  • Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering.

  • Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

  • Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré.

Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen.

Het team

Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

 
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een salaris van €4.500,- tot €5.750,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner, Support Platform & AI
jobs.description:
About Jimdo

We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses.

Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world.

We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward.

At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward.

Role Overview

At Jimdo, we think the best support is the one a customer never needs. When our customers, self-employed people and small business owners, do need help, it should come fast: from self-service and AI first, and from a person when that's what the case needs.

We're bringing our support tooling, Zendesk, chatbots and AI work together into one team with one backlog and one roadmap. As Senior Product Owner, you'll lead that team and own the outcome: more questions answered by AI, faster help, lower cost to serve, and customers who still trust us.

You'll also shape where this goes next. Over the next couple of years AI will handle more and more first-line support, and you'll decide how the work is split between AI and people, and build the platform around it.

 

The team and who you'll work with

You'll report to the Head of Customer Support Services and join CSS, our support organisation.

You'll lead a small team of Zendesk and AI specialists and work day to day with the engineers who build our support tools.

You'll work closely with our knowledge and readiness team, support agents and team leads, product teams, our Company AI team, Data & Analytics, and our support and AI vendors.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Set the vision for our support platform and AI with the Head of CSS, and turn it into a roadmap, a business case and results.

  • Lead, coach and grow your team, and bring specialists and engineers together around one backlog and clear quarterly outcomes.

  • Own how well our chatbot, Zendesk AI agents and Copilot perform: define what a good AI answer is, measure it, and switch off what doesn't help customers.

  • Improve routing, user identification and self-service entry points so customers get to the right answer faster.

  • Spend real time with customers and support agents: read tickets, listen to chats, see where people get stuck.

  • Build a written case for every bigger piece of work, own the cost to serve, and check results against your forecast.

  • Turn what you learn in support into evidence that helps product teams fix problems at the source.

Your first months

  • After 3 months: your team works from one backlog and one outcome roadmap, and the quality bar for AI answers is agreed.

  • After 6 months: you've delivered and reported your first quarterly outcome, including how AI resolution compares with your forecast.

What you bring to the table

  • 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally including support, CX, service or internal platform products.

  • You've shipped AI or chatbot features in production and can name the metric you moved, the baseline and the result.

  • You explain product decisions in commercial terms: cost, savings, effect, and what you learned when a forecast was wrong.

  • You've managed people and led people who didn't report to you, ideally across departments.

  • You do your own analysis with SQL or BI tools, and design and read experiments without waiting for an analyst.

  • A clear point of view on what a good support experience is, and fluent English for everyday work.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Zendesk (or a similar tool such as Intercom or Salesforce Service Cloud), including AI agents, routing and automations.

  • Experience using support insights to change a product team's roadmap.

  • German language skills.

What we offer:

Inspiring Mission: At our core, we are driven by a meaningful mission - to  empower solopreneurs and small businesses to succeed and  to contribute to the sustainability and vibrancy of the communities they serve.

Flexibility and Trust: Our work environment thrives on flexibility and trust. We offer fully remote work set-up  with opportunities for in-person collaboration. You can manage your working hours flexibly because we prioritize the results you deliver over the number of hours you put in. 

An International Diverse Team: Our team is a mosaic of over 248 individuals hailing from 50+ different countries and working across 15+ diverse locations. We take pride in our openness and inclusivity.

Continuous  Growth and Career Development: We invest in your growth with company-wide access to LinkedIn Learning and curated learning paths. From day one, you have the chance to contribute your ideas and create a meaningful impact. Our flat hierarchies and swift decision-making processes provide an open platform for your career progression.

Competitive Benefits Package: 

  • Annual compensation reviews to ensure you're rewarded fairly.

  • A remote office set-up bonus to enhance your workspace.

  • An employee assistance program, offering resources and counseling.

  • Plus, a perk that keeps giving: up to three free Jimdo websites for your personal or professional projects that you get to keep forever.

Jimdo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. This means that we don’t discriminate based on race or ethnic origin, color, the language(s) you speak, where you (or your parents) are from, or whether or not you consider yourself to have a disability. Neither will your age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, beliefs, or political opinions play a part in your application with us. Our diverse team values and celebrates the uniqueness of each individual. We embrace differences and believe that they enrich our organization, making us stronger and more innovative. Join us, and let's continue to create a workplace where everyone can thrive, regardless of background or identity.

Product Manager, Device Data Management (Français/Anglais)

Lieu : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)
Niveau : Senior Product Manager
Équipe : Device Data Management (DDM)
Contrat : CDI

À noter : ce poste est basé en France. Vous devez donc y résider ou être prêt·e à déménager, et disposer déjà du droit de travailler dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous l’examinons poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir.

Un français et un anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous demandons de soumettre votre CV en anglais.À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel à travers les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez :

Vous serez responsable de la localisation française de Device Data Management (DDM), l’un des domaines produit clés de la plateforme Kaluza. DDM consomme des flux de données internes et externes pour représenter les fournitures, compteurs, registres, relevés et consommations. Il gère aussi les parcours liés à ces entités (par exemple, la mise à jour de la configuration d’un compteur), les API qui exposent les données, les pages front-end qui les présentent aux utilisateurs, ainsi que les calculs de projection et d’extrapolation de consommation. C’est un rôle produit full-stack et très opérationnel : vous interviendrez sur tout le domaine, du modèle de données jusqu’à ce que voient les utilisateurs à l’écran.

  • Traduire les exigences du marché français en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché de l’énergie français (Enedis, GRDF, passerelle GRD, règles sur les données de compteurs et d’équipements) en exigences produit détaillées couvrant la conformité réglementaire, les flux de données des équipements et la qualité des données.

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec nos clients : collaborer main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché français pour comprendre leurs besoins et construire les exigences ensemble. Bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vous voir en premier, et vous appuyer sur cette proximité pour orienter ce que DDM construira ensuite pour la France.

  • Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel en interrogeant les données, en esquissant des contrats d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez quotidiennement des outils d’IA (ex. Claude Code) comme multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer des situations, et pas seulement pour rédiger des documents.

  • Aligner les équipes globales et locales, toutes fonctions confondues : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, la QA et bien d’autres, avec une influence full-stack, pour que tout le monde vise les bons résultats.

  • Être la personne de référence pour DDM France : faire le lien entre nos équipes globales et locales afin d’éclairer les priorités et la stratégie.

Ce que vous apportez :

Critères essentiels :

  • Une expérience avérée en tant que Product Manager, Business Analyst ou équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un solide historique de localisation réussie de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux

  • Un français courant et une grande aisance en anglais : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, vous passez donc facilement de l’un à l’autre

  • De l’aisance dans le travail direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les décideurs alignés et impliqués

  • Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard·e et opérationnel·le, vous préférez construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt qu’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous pouvez tenir une conversation technique. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur·e, mais vous raisonnez comme tel·le, et vous êtes aussi à l’aise pour réfléchir à un modèle de données que pour penser à ce que l’utilisateur voit à l’écran

  • Une communication claire et incisive, capable de faire le tri dans le bruit et d’expliquer la complexité technique et de marché à des interlocuteurs variés, clients compris, ainsi qu’une expérience de collaboration avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (ingénierie, QA, BA, Programme, Delivery, etc.) pour livrer des solutions localisées

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Une expérience dans le secteur de l’énergie en France : vous connaissez le fonctionnement du marché et ses acteurs clés (ex. Enedis / GRDF), notamment sur les données d’équipements et les flux de marché

  • Une expérience avec des plateformes de gestion de l’énergie ou de services publics (utilities) sur le marché français

  • Une bonne maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la découverte et l’idéation jusqu’à la livraison et l’itération

  • Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

 

Nos avantages

 

  • Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès x3) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

  • Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

jobs.title: Strategic Project Manager Italy
jobs.description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

 

Join us as a Strategic Project Manager – Country Support (Italy) to help shape Qonto’s strategy in Italy and turn local priorities into action. Working with Fanny, our Strategy Director, and Italy’s country leadership, you’ll combine market insights, strategic planning and hands-on project leadership to support growth in the Italian market.

You’ll join a Strategy talent pool where you can learn quickly, collaborate across teams and potentially grow into another function over time, such as Growth, Operations, Product or Tech.

➡️ What you’ll do

  • Understand the Italian market: Analyze market trends, customer needs, regulation and competition to anticipate their impact on Qonto and identify opportunities for growth.

  • Shape the country strategy and plan: Work with Italy’s country leadership to identify opportunities and define and refresh the country strategy and priorities, connecting local opportunities with Qonto’s wider strategic plan. Track progress against the plan with the Finance Business Partner.

  • Develop the strategy per segment: Analyze the market and customer base to define and refresh strategies for different customer segments and identify new business opportunities.

  • Drive strategic projects from framing to execution: Assess the potential, scope, business case and strategic rationale of key initiatives supporting Italy’s priorities and OKRs. Lead or coordinate execution where needed, and hand projects over to country teams when ready. Projects will vary with country priorities and could include exploring a company-creation offering. Strong stakeholder management is essential.

➡️ What we’re looking for

  • Experience: You have around 4–5 years or more of relevant experience in strategic project management, consulting and/or a hands-on role in a startup or company. Consulting experience is useful but not required; experience in banking, payments or fintech is a plus, not a prerequisite.

  • Analytical mindset: You enjoy exploring complex questions, researching markets and turning insights into clear, structured recommendations and action plans.

  • Communication & synthesis: You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and can structure and present your ideas to a range of stakeholders.

  • Project & stakeholder management: You can lead cross-functional projects, build alignment across teams and break down silos to move priorities forward.

  • Ownership & pragmatism: You’re proactive, detail-oriented and hands-on. You take responsibility for your projects, from planning through execution, and follow through on delivery.

  • Collaboration: You’re a team player who builds constructive relationships and energizes the people you work with.

  • Curiosity & AI: You’re interested in financial services and eager to learn and experiment with AI in your work. Advanced AI expertise is not required.

  • Languages: Fluency in Italian and English is required.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Team & impact: Join the Strategy team and play a key role in shaping Qonto’s strategy and driving strategic projects in Italy.

  • Exposure & collaboration: Work closely with country leadership, senior management and international teams across Growth, Product, Tech, Finance, Operations and Compliance.

  • From strategy to execution: Stay close to the business, with opportunities to move from market analysis and strategic decisions to concrete local initiatives and outcomes.

  • Learning & growth: Benefit from coaching and exposure to different areas of Qonto, with opportunities to grow within the Strategy team and potentially explore roles in other functions over time.

  • AI & ways of working: Experiment with AI on projects and exchange practices with the team during strategy office hours.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Fanny De Vesinne-Larüe, our Strategy Director.

  • Her background: Fanny has been at Qonto for four years, spotting new opportunities and driving key projects to help Qonto accelerate. Before joining Qonto, she held roles across strategy, marketing, venture and e-business at financial institutions including AXA and BNP Paribas, working with fintechs and startups.

  • What she brings to the team: Fanny supports team members through coaching, exposure to different functions and conversations about their development and potential future moves within Qonto.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
