jobs.title: Process Improvement Project Manager
jobs.description:
Your next mission

Turn operational complexity into smooth performance – so every radar system is built, shipped, and supported without a hitch.

As our Process Improvement Project Manager, you lead, execute, and deliver continuous improvement projects across our operational footprint. You work side-by-side with colleagues in Production, Logistics, Procurement, Service, Sales Operations, Engineering, Quality, and IT – diagnosing root causes, designing scalable workflows, and embedding smooth processes into daily routines. You report to the Operational Excellence Manager, playing a vital role in enabling Robin Radar to scale smoothly as our global impact grows.

What you'll do

  • End-to-end project leadership: Lead operational improvement projects from initial diagnosis through post-implementation. Support business growth and capacity scaling across all operational teams.

  • Workflow analysis and SOP design: Deep-dive into operational workflows to identify waste and perform root-cause analysis. Translate findings into scalable standard operating procedures.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner directly with operational leads and frontline floor teams to bridge functional silos. Facilitate smooth handovers to remove bottlenecks and execution friction.

  • Change management and coaching: Coach and enable operational teams through active change management. Ensure optimized processes become lasting daily working habits.

  • Metrics and KPI tracking: Define project metrics, establish baseline KPIs, and build tracking dashboards. Measure and validate performance improvements continuously over time.

  • Tool configuration and adoption: Translate optimized workflows into practical software tools. Manage configuration and user adoption in Jira, ERP (Odoo), and supporting platforms.

What you bring

  • BSc or MSc degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, or Business Administration

  • 7+ years delivering hands-on process improvement projects in fast-growing high-tech or manufacturing environments

  • Certified Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt, or equivalent Agile certification

  • Practical mastery of Lean toolkits including Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, 5 Whys, and Pareto analysis

  • Proven ability to manage multiple improvement projects concurrently in fast-paced, ambiguous settings

  • Practical experience configuring workflow tools like Jira and driving user adoption in ERP systems like Odoo

  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English, with Dutch proficiency considered a strong asset

  • Action-oriented execution mindset, comfortable working directly with frontline shop floor teams

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills across all levels of an organization.

What we offer

  • Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

  • Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

  • High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role;

  • An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning?

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

jobs.title: Senior Producer
Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
jobs.description:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. 

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.

 
Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.

 
Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

 
Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.

 
Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

•    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;   

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
•    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
•    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
•    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
•    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
•    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
•    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
•    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.

 
•    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
•    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
•    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
•    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
•    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
•    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
•    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
•    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
•    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
•    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
•    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
•    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.
 

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. 


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

Overige informatie

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Hardware Abstraction
jobs.description:
At Oxa, we're building the future of Industrial Mobile Autonomy (IMA) and are in the market for new talent.

Oxa’s customers are the operators of some of the world's largest industrial facilities. Our technology transforms existing industrial vehicles into intelligent autonomous fleets, unlocking new levels of productivity, safety, and performance.

 

‘The phone in your hand, the coffee on your desk, the shirt on your back - they all moved through a web of ports (air and sea), distribution yards and manufacturing hubs. This is the invisible circulatory system of global trade, and it relies entirely on a relentless, repetitive shuffle of goods. Towing.

This towing task happens in complex, commerce-critical industrial environments. Here, having self driving technology “do the driving” delivers immediate, measurable impact. IMA will revolutionise the movement of goods across the world's ports, airports, and yards.

You can be part of that as an Oxbot’

‘Paul Newman - Founder and CEO’

 

Our Products:

Our products are built on four core technology pillars which come together to build a complete system:

Oxa Ware – Our modular autonomy hardware systems for consistent and repeatable integration of autonomy with existing vehicles.

Oxa Driver – Our Physical AI, embodied in Oxa Ware, self-driving software that enables vehicles to perceive, reason, and drive autonomously in complex real-world environments.

Oxa Foundry – Our development toolchain that leverages generative AI to continuously train and assure Oxa Driver, synthesising situations and sensor data.

Oxa Hub – Our suite of cloud services for monitoring, managing and orchestrating fleets driven by Oxa Driver, including an API for integration with existing logistics systems.

 

Behind these technologies is our exceptional team, the Oxbots. We are home to some of the world's leading experts in autonomous systems, robotics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and distributed software engineering. Together, we're solving some of the hardest technical challenges in autonomy, turning the research and development we do into production and deploying it into environments. Making robots do useful work.

 

Your Team:

You will join the Hardware Abstraction layer of Oxa Driver: the teams that sit between our autonomy software and the vehicles it drives. They make one autonomy stack run safely on many different industrial vehicles, so their scope scales with each vehicle platform we integrate.

Hardware Abstraction is a group of teams responsible for:

  • safety-rated collision avoidance, and the evidence that supports product certification

  • vehicle and driving models that turn planned motion into commands each vehicle can execute

  • the on-vehicle safety controllers and the software that runs on them

  • the vehicle interface: the configuration and signal mapping that adapt the stack to each vehicle type

  • bringing new vehicle types into service, including retrofit drive-by-wire

The teams work closely with Integration & Test, Autonomy Applications, Vehicle Engineering, our safety team, and external hardware suppliers and vehicle manufacturers.

Your Role:

You are the delivery enabler for the Hardware Abstraction teams. You coordinate delivery so the teams can plan, build, test and ship with less friction, and their leads can focus on engineering.

You will work with engineering, product and solutions leaders across the stack who own customer outcomes. Your focus is to make sure the Hardware Abstraction layer delivers what it committed to, predictably, with its dependencies visible early.

This layer succeeds or fails on real vehicles and test rigs, so you will spend one to two

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Plans the teams can deliver: Take the layer's commitments in our product engineering plan and, with the leads, turn them into sequenced work with dates and a clear definition of done.

  • A delivery rhythm that fits: Run planning, stand-ups and retros in a format that suits each team, including the fast cadence that hardware bring-up needs. Keep Jira as the source of truth.

  • Dependencies, seen early: Track what the teams need from others and what others need from them, raise conflicts early and broker the trade-offs:

    • hardware kits, test vehicles, rigs and track time

    • supplier and vehicle-manufacturer software releases

    • handoffs to Integration & Test and Autonomy Applications

  • On-site coordination: Be the delivery presence at our vehicle sites. Get vehicle and rig time booked, and parts and people in the right place. Feed test results back into the plan.

  • Risk and change control: Keep risks visible and acted on. Make sure changes to safety-critical software and vehicle configuration follow the agreed change process, working with our safety team.

  • Reporting that saves leads' time: Report monthly progress against plan, and the health of the defect and field-issue backlog. Use simple metrics to show whether delivery is getting more predictable.

  • Better ways of working: Find the friction, such as manual steps, unclear ownership or missing test gates, and drive fixes with the teams.

    What you need to succeed:

  • A career started in engineering (a degree in electrical, mechatronic, automotive, software, robotics or similar) and have moved into delivery, with 2+ years as a TPM, project engineer or delivery manager on a technical product.

  • Knowledge of the hardware–software lifecycle: You know how work moves through requirements, supplier and ECU integration, bring-up, bench and vehicle testing, release and field support. Hands-on experience of hardware or vehicle bring-up and testing is preferred but not essential.

  • Vehicle-systems fluency: Enough to follow the engineering and ask good questions: CAN, ECUs, embedded and Linux platforms, sensors.

  • Organised and clear: You break down work, map dependencies and forecast from data (using tools like Jira, Confluence and Miro), and you build trust with engineers when priorities shift.

 

Extra kudos if you have:

  • Experience in automotive, robotics, off-highway or industrial vehicles.

  • Exposure to functional safety (ISO 13849, ISO 26262) or CE marking.

  • Experience working with hardware suppliers or vehicle OEMs, or on vehicle bring-up and commissioning.

  • Experience running agile delivery in a mixed hardware and software environment.

  • Comfort with Git-based planning, documentation-as-code, or AI tools for reporting.

Your Interview Experience:

Our interview process is designed to give you every chance to get the measure of us, and us of you. You will join three stages which will give you every opportunity to show your strengths and qualities, via scenario based questions and technical exercises.

 

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary benchmarked against the market

  • Participation in a great company equity scheme

  • Enhanced pension contributions

  • Annual holiday allowance of 25 days per year

  • Overseas working policy for up to 8 weeks per year

  • Flexible, hybrid and remote working arrangements

  • Comprehensive Private Health cover with the option to add family members,

  • Enhanced health and wellbeing benefits including health cash plan, critical illness cover, life assurance and group income protection

  • Enhanced paid maternity and paternity policy

 

If you're excited by deep technical problems, real-world AI, and the opportunity to build technology that will reshape global industry, you'll find both the challenge and the impact you're looking for at Oxa.

jobs.title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
jobs.description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

    • If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

  • Design journeys and loops that compound, from first touch to purchase, renewal and referral.

  • Establish AI-enabled workflows for your domain, from generating test variants to automated funnel analysis.

  • Bring stakeholders along, running ceremonies with senior stakeholders, facilitating big-room planning and knowing when to escalate.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Growth product ownership. A track record of leading consumer growth - acquisition, conversion, retention or monetisation - in a high-growth environment.

As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This role is based in UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 
 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analist / Product Owner E-health
jobs.description:
Met je hoofd in de ICT, je hart bij de zorg en oog voor de mogelijkheden van AI.

Over PharmaPartners en eHealth

PharmaPartners ontwikkelt en beheert zorgsystemen voor de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg. Wij zijn een organisatie met een uitgesproken visie én aanpak op continue vernieuwing met de focus op groei. Daar kan jij een bijdrage aan leveren.

De business unit eHealth levert vernieuwende producten aan huisartsen en apotheken ter ondersteuning van hun patiënten. Met ons online portaal en onze app kunnen patiënten communiceren met hun huisarts en apotheek en onder andere hun medisch dossier inzien. Ruim 8 miljoen patiënten maken gebruik van ons portaal. Daarmee zijn we een van de grootste spelers op het gebied van e-health in de Nederlandse eerstelijnszorg.


Binnen Research & Development zetten we volop in op AI en agentic development. AI wordt steeds meer onderdeel van de manier waarop we analyseren, ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, testen en documenteren. Als Business Analist / Product Owner speel je hierin een actieve rol: je benut de mogelijkheden van AI, houdt regie op de inhoud en bewaakt samen met het team de kwaliteit, veiligheid en toepasbaarheid van de resultaten.

Jouw rol

Als Senior Business Analist / Product Owner ben je de brug tussen de business, klanten, gebruikers en development, met een leidende rol in de productontwikkeling. Je draagt bij aan de productvisie en roadmap en vertaalt die naar heldere prioriteiten voor de teams. Je begrijpt de behoeften van gebruikers en vertaalt deze naar functionele vereisten, technische specificaties en concrete ontwikkelvoorstellen.

Je werkt in een complexe en veranderende omgeving en houdt overzicht wanneer er veel tegelijk speelt. Je kijkt niet alleen naar wat vandaag nodig is, maar vooral naar wat morgen waarde levert: nieuwe marktontwikkelingen, innovatiekansen en de mogelijkheden van AI. Je neemt eigenaarschap over de volledige levenscyclus van je producten en je coacht collega’s in het vak. Je helpt het team om AI en agentic development verantwoord en effectief in te zetten binnen het ontwikkelproces.


Daarnaast vind jij het leuk om:

  • De behoeften van verschillende belanghebbenden, waaronder onze klanten en gebruikers, in kaart te brengen, documenteren en met elkaar in overeenstemming te brengen;

  • Eén of meer of meerdere scrum teams aan te sturen, die je begeleid in het ontwikkelproces volgens de SCRUM methodiek (planning, retrospective, refinements, e.d.);

  • De kwaliteit van de producten te waarborgen en continu te verbeteren door afstemming met de ontwikkelteams en alle betrokken stakeholders;

  • De schakel te zijn tussen klant en organisatie, waarbij je de klantwensen vertaalt naar concrete voorstellen en deze prioriteert op een product backlog;

  • AI in te zetten ter ondersteuning van bijvoorbeeld analyse, requirements, prototyping, documentatie en voorbereiding van refinements (natuurlijk zorg je ook voor een grondige controle, review en validatie op de output van AI;

  • De kwaliteit van producten bewaken en borgen dat deze voldoen aan de kwaliteits-, product- en informatiebeveiligingsnormen, in afstemming met ontwikkelteams en stakeholders;

  • De product backlog creëren, prioriteren en onderhouden, zodat het developmentteam aan de juiste ontwikkelingen werkt.

Werken met AI en agentic development

AI verandert de manier waarop software wordt ontwikkeld. Binnen PharmaPartners werken R&D-teams toe naar een gedeelde agentic way of working. De mens blijft verantwoordelijk voor keuzes en resultaten, terwijl AI ondersteunt bij onderdelen van het werk. Daarom zoeken we iemand die kansen ziet, kritisch blijft en nieuwe werkwijzen snel eigen maakt.

Heb je al ervaring met AI-tools, AI-agents, skills, prompten of agentic development? Dan is dat een duidelijke pré. Heb je die ervaring nog niet, maar ben je nieuwsgierig, leergierig en bereid je hierin actief onder te dompelen? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je werkt in een enthousiast Portfolio- en R&D-team en rapporteert aan de Teamlead Portfolio. Je levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste eHealth-platformen van Nederland en hebt als senior invloed op de koers van het product en de werkwijze van het team. Dat doe je samen met open, eerlijke, en behulpzame collega’s in een hechte en informele organisatie.


Herken jij je hierin?

  • Jij hebt minimaal HBO+ werk- en denkniveau in de richting van bedrijfskunde, IT, zorgtechnologie of iets soortgelijks;

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in de zorg-ICT, in een rol als business analist of product owner;

  • Jouw kennis van de Nederlandse taal zit op minimaal C2-niveau. Ook in het Engels kun jij je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken;

  • Ruime ervaring met business analysetechnieken en het documenteren van requirements, ook bij complexe vraagstukken;

  • Je hebt ervaring met het bijdragen aan productvisie en roadmap en met het prioriteren op basis van strategische doelen;

  • Je vindt het niet erg als jouw werkdag soms anders loopt, of buiten een vast 9 tot 5 patroon valt;

  • Je deelt gemakkelijk kennis (van de Nederlandse zorgmarkt) en informatie met anderen;

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen, ook als de druk op je werk toeneemt en houdt altijd overzicht.

Je bent communicatief vaardig, ambitieus en gedisciplineerd. Je durft vragen te stellen, keuzes te onderbouwen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, en je neemt anderen mee in je koers. Tegelijk werk je graag samen, sta je open voor feedback en heb je de nieuwsgierigheid en het lef om nieuwe technologie verantwoord toe te passen.

Klaar om samen met ons de koers van eHealth en softwareontwikkeling te bepalen?

Dan zoeken we jou!

En is dit wat je zoekt?

  • Een passend salaris: Voor deze vacature geldt een range van € 4.000 - € 5.500 bruto p/m op basis van een fulltime werkweek.

  • €500,- persoonlijk budget: Gebruik het voor een sportabonnement, of investeer in je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • 26 vakantiedagen en 8,33% vakantiegeld: Eventueel kun je zelfs nog 5 extra vakantiedagen erbij kopen (naar rato).

  • Beschikbare pensioenpremie: wij zijn aangesloten bij Allianz en bieden een premie met een eigen bijdrage van 4,8%.

  • Ruimte voor groei: Binnen PharmaPartners bieden wij diverse Talentenprogamma’s aan, die gericht zijn op persoonlijke ontwikkeling, het inzetten van jouw talent en kracht en een programma om erachter te komen of dat jij jezelf in een leidinggevende rol ziet!

  • Een hechte, open werksfeer: Ervaar een warme, open werkomgeving waar collega’s samen successen vieren. Binnen PharmaPartners zorgt de Brabantse gezelligheid voor een laagdrempelige benadering en een sterke teamspirit.

  • Leaseauto : Wij bieden jou een leaseregeling aan zodat jij met goed vervoer jouw klanten kunt bezoeken.

  • Uitdagende functie: Ga de uitdaging aan bij een organisatie die impact maakt in de samenleving in de zorgsector. Je draagt direct bij aan de maatschappij door te werken voor de zorg, waar jouw inzet het verschil maakt.

  • Sporten onder werktijd: Bij PharmaPartners moedigen we een gezonde levensstijl aan, inclusief sporten onder werktijd. Op dinsdag en donderdag heb je de mogelijkheid om samen met collega’s aan het eind van de dag te gaan sporten.

  • Hybride werken: Hybride werken bij ons betekent dat je twee keer per week op kantoor wordt verwacht, terwijl je de rest van de tijd de vrijheid hebt om vanuit huis te werken. Deze aanpak zorgt voor een balans van interactie en flexibiliteit.

  • Teamspirit: Versterk de teamgeest door deel te nemen aan diverse sportevenementen, zoals een tennistoernooi of de singelloop in Breda. Bouw samen met je collega's aan een hechter team.

Location: Zürich, on-site

About Us

We are an early-stage startup that builds the future of how individuals and healthcare providers will interact with health related data. Our vision is to make complex medical data accessible, understandable and actionable for everyone through responsible use of AI. One of our products is a consumer mobile application that integrates with our health partners and is based on our intelligent data platform. To drive its further development, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Product Manager.

The Role

You will be responsible for shaping the product vision and roadmap with the team, creating an experience that patients and physicians find immediately valuable. Partnering closely with the engineering and business teams, you will translate complex AI functionality into a trusted, globally scalable product that grows through our partners and its own value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop an inspiring product vision that aligns with the broader startup strategy and creates meaningful value for patients and healthcare professionals and partners

You will join a small team in a fast moving environment. You will have meaningful ownership without being expected to manage a team initially.

jobs.description:
Product Manager, Lead to Cash

Location: London, onsite 5 days a week

Retire The ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers: automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. We’re an early team defining a new software category. If you’re excited to modernise how the world runs money, one agentic workflow at a time, you’re in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we’re building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

About The Role

This is a hands-on product role reporting to the VP of Product Development. You’ll own Lead to Cash: everything between a signed deal and cash in the bank. That covers contracts, billing and invoicing, revenue recognition, payments, and credit control. You’ll set the roadmap for the area with the VP, and your discovery and judgement decide what actually ships.

In Lead to Cash, the ledger has to keep up with whatever commercial terms each customer signs. A contract changes mid-term, and the invoices, deferred revenue and reporting all have to follow. A parent company wants one bill for a dozen subsidiaries. A customer’s Stripe setup doesn’t match how they actually sell. Every customer bills a little differently, and the product has to absorb those differences without turning into a pile of one-offs. You work out which problems are patterns worth building for and which aren’t, and you say so.

Your stakeholders are engineers, designers, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, and the Financial Controllers, Finance Directors and CFOs who run their revenue on Light. Most of them are senior, technical and short of time. They expect you to keep up, and to be honest with them when a request would cost more than it’s worth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Lead to Cash roadmap and its delivery, from discovery to go-live, and the metrics that show whether it’s working for customers

  • Turn contract terms, pricing models and revenue recognition rules into product requirements engineers can build from

  • Decide which customer requests become product and which don’t, and bring a clear recommendation to the VP of Product Development when the call is a big one

  • Lead discovery with finance teams: sit with them through a billing run or a month-end close and find what’s slow, manual or wrong

  • Work with Sales and Solutions Engineering on what gets promised to customers, before it’s promised

  • Sequence delivery with Engineering and Design without cutting the corners that matter in finance

  • Own the integrations that feed Lead to Cash, such as CRMs and payment providers, with clear scope for each

  • Spot a release going off-track before it slips, and escalate or intervene early

  • Enable the teams downstream of you (Sales, SE, Implementation, Support) to sell, set up and support every Lead to Cash feature from day one

  • Shape how AI agents run billing and collections work, inside policies that finance teams set and can audit

Experience & Qualifications*

We’re looking for someone with around 4–8 years in product (or equivalent experience), who brings:

  • You ship product, not slideware. You’ve owned real features that real users depend on. You measure yourself by what went live and what it changed, not by the roadmap you maintained. This is the non-negotiable.

  • You turn accounting rules into product. You can read IFRS 15 or ASC 606, a customer’s master services agreement, or a messy pricing sheet and work out what the product has to do. You know why a mid-term upgrade, a backdated discount or an early termination breaks a simple billing model, and you design for it before a customer finds it.

  • You know revenue. You understand order-to-cash in practice: contracts, billing schedules, deferred and recognised revenue, credit notes, dunning, and matching cash against invoices. You can talk confidently with a Controller about how revenue should land in the books. An accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA or local equivalent) is a strong plus, and so is time spent running billing or revenue operations yourself.

  • You can say no, explain why, and keep the relationship intact. Lead to Cash attracts customer-specific requests, and many arrive already promised. You can tell a pattern from a one-off, explain the cost of each to Sales and to customers, and turn the patterns into product that serves the next customer as well as this one.

  • You’re AI-native. You’ve changed the way you work because of AI tooling, not just added it to your workflow. You use it to read contracts and pricing models, prototype, draft specs and pressure-test your own thinking, and you have an instinct for where it helps, where it misleads, and how to use it without losing ownership of the outcome.

  • You own discovery. You talk to customers directly and often: their finance teams, the people who run their billing, and our own Sales and Implementation teams who set them up. You can tell the difference between what a customer asks for and the problem underneath it, and you turn that into the smallest thing worth building next.

  • You deliver through other people. You’ve shipped through Product, Engineering, Design and Sales without formal authority over any of them. You build trust with senior finance stakeholders through clear communication and consistent delivery.

  • Fluent English; additional European languages a plus.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building billing, subscription or revenue recognition products, or running billing at a SaaS company

  • Familiarity with billing and payment platforms such as Stripe, Chargebee or Zuora, and CRMs such as HubSpot or Salesforce

  • Experience in fintech or systems where data integrity is non-negotiable

  • Experience with usage-based, tiered or hybrid pricing models

  • Background in high-growth startups where everything was still being figured out

  • Familiarity with multi-currency, multi-entity billing and e-invoicing mandates (e.g. Peppol, Italy’s SDI)

You’ll Probably Struggle Here If

  • You need a finished spec handed to you. Here the “requirement” is often a contract clause or a pricing sheet nobody has turned into product yet.

  • You need a PMO, a mature methodology or a big delivery org around you to operate. This is a startup environment, and ownership and a self-starter nature are key.

  • You treat every customer request as a commitment. The job is deciding which ones become product.

  • You find it hard to say no to a customer or colleague, even when it’s the right call.

  • You haven’t yet changed how you work because of AI. We go all in on AI at Light and want people who share that.

Our Tech Stack

We build on AWS, with a Kotlin backend, a React frontend, and infrastructure managed in Terraform. It’s a real production system that global finance teams depend on every day.

You won’t be writing the code, but you’ll live alongside it. You do need to be comfortable in this kind of environment: real scale, real customers, real stakes.

The Good Stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options.
🏝 A generous paid annual leave package, plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you help shape a market-defining product.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

Working at Light means you’re embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat code is that we’ve built something like this before, and now we’re doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

Join the rocket ship while it’s taking off 🚀

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager LogicSteel Ben jij een ondernemende Product Manager die kansen ziet waar anderen ze nog niet zien? Krijg jij energie van het doorgronden van complexe productieprocessen en weet je deze te vertalen naar slimme, innovatieve softwareoplossingen? Wil jij de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, richting te geven aan productontwikkeling en écht impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische organisatie? Dan is dit jouw kans!

 

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Product Manager LogicSteel ben jij dé drijvende kracht achter het doorgronden van productieprocessen en het vertalen daarvan naar slimme oplossingen binnen LogicSteel. LogicSteel is ons cloud-based software platform voor de staalverwerkende industrie. Middels LogicSteel wordt de ontwerpfase, werkvoorbereiding en productie naadloos met elkaar verbonden. Wat kunnen klanten uit LogicSteel halen? Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het automatisch plannen en inkopen van al het materiaal voor productie, het optimaliseren van het proces voor nesting op basis van voorraad en beschikbaarheid, het realtime volgen van het volledige productieproces én het aansturen van onze machines.

 

In deze sleutelrol duik jij in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers. Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk, staat dicht bij de klant en verdiept je in de stappen en randvoorwaarden voor hun productieproces. Door regelmatig klanten in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken, krijg je scherp inzicht in de productieprocessen, knelpunten en kansen voor optimalisatie. Hierbij doorgrond je welke stappen bepalend zijn, welke beperkingen een limitatie vormen en waar liggen kansen om slimmer te werken? Deze inzichten vertaal je naar generieke, herbruikbare product-capabilities die in verschillende processen waarde toevoegen – van 3D-modeling tot machinebewegingen. Vervolgens werk je initiatieven uit tot concrete productrequirements waarmee Product Owners aan de slag kunnen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met multidisciplinaire teams om te zorgen dat software, processen en machines naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. In deze rol houd je continu grip op de voortgang, kwaliteit en impact van LogicSteel-oplossingen, en stuur je waar nodig bij om het beste resultaat te behalen.

 

Maar dat is nog niet alles. Als Product Manager LogicSteel bewaak jij de samenhang binnen het platform. Je zorgt ervoor dat processen, knelpunten, afhankelijkheden en product-capabilities goed worden vastgelegd en gecommuniceerd, zodat Product Owners, engineering en consultancy vanuit hetzelfde beeld werken. Je communiceert helder over de gemaakte keuzes, stemt af met betrokken teams en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een samenhangend LogicSteel-platform. Daarnaast draag je actief bij aan productintroducties en de doorontwikkeling van onze software-oplossingen.

 

Samenvattend bestaan jouw verantwoordelijkheden uit het:

  • doorgronden en structureren van complexe productieprocessen bij staalverwerkende organisaties;

  • bezoeken van (internationale) klanten om processen te begrijpen en nieuwe kansen te identificeren;

  • vertalen van pijnpunten en klanbehoeften naar generieke herbruikbare product-capabilities, van 3D modeling tot machinebewegingen;

  • identificeren waar vergelijkbare capabilities in verschillende processen kunnen worden toegepast;

  • bepalen welke functionaliteiten en innovaties worden ontwikkeld;

  • opstellen van een helder werkpakket met productrequirements voor de Product Owners en het bewaken van de voortgang;

  • intensief samenwerken met Product Owners, Engineers en Consultants om software, processen en machines optimaal op elkaar te laten aansluiten;

  • bewaken van de samenhang binnen LogicSteel en het consistent vastleggen van klantprocessen, knelpunten en capabilities;

  • bijdragen aan succesvolle productintroducties en doorontwikkeling.

 

Wat maakt deze functie zo bijzonder?

“Je bent een ondernemer binnen onze onderneming”, aldus collega Luc. Jij verdiept je in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers en ontdekt waar complexe stappen, beperkingen en afhankelijkheden om slimme oplossingen vragen. Je weet die processen te doorgronden en te vertalen naar herbruikbare capabilities die niet alleen één klant helpen, maar binnen het gehele LogicSteel-platform van waarde zijn. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met verschillende disciplines en bouw je dagelijks aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen!

 

Warm en professioneel bad

Bij ons werk je niet zomaar voor een bedrijf, maar voor een familiebedrijf waar mensen centraal staan. Je merkt het in alles: de korte lijnen, de betrokkenheid en de ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen. Ondernemerschap zit in het DNA van de organisatie. Heb je een goed idee? Dan krijg je de vrijheid en het vertrouwen om dit verder te brengen en écht impact te maken.

 

Daarnaast kennen we elkaar, nemen we verantwoordelijkheid en staan we voor elkaar klaar. Dat zie je terug in de manier waarop we samenwerken: teams trekken veel met elkaar op, denken over domeinen heen en zoeken actief de verbinding. Die open en ondersteunende houding zorgt niet alleen voor sterke resultaten, maar ook voor een werksfeer waarin je je snel thuis voelt. Zoals een collega het mooi zegt: “Doordat we er voor elkaar zijn, kunnen we kwaliteit leveren én zorgen we voor een prettige werksfeer – met ruimte voor een gezonde dosis humor en gezelligheid.”

 

Tegelijkertijd is er veel aandacht voor jouw persoonlijke groei. We kijken naar talent, potentie en kwaliteit, en bieden ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en stappen te zetten. Of zoals collega Luc het verwoordt: “Ik ben als stagiaire begonnen en heb de kans gekregen om door te groeien tot eindverantwoordelijke voor de business unit LogicSteel. Kortom, binnen ons bedrijf is veel mogelijk.”

 

Wij vragen

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in Industrial Engineering & Management / Technische Bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Software Engineering, Business IT & Management of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;

  • Het vermogen om complexe (productie)processen te ontrafelen, te structureren en inzichtelijk te maken;

  • Een sterk abstractievermogen en het talent om generieke capabilities te herkennen die ook in andere processen bruikbaar zijn;

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om processen en afhankelijkheden te vertalen naar heldere, concrete productrequirements;

  • Het vermogen om de samenhang tussen verschillende onderdelen van een softwareplatform te overzien en te bewaken;

  • Het talent om overzicht te behouden omtrent de productontwikkeling;

  • Het vermogen om helder af te stemmen, intern draagvlak te creëren en effectief samen te werken met Product Owners, engineers en consultants;

  • Kennis van productieprocessen in de staalbouw, werkvoorbereiding en/of calculatie is een sterke pre;

  • Een nieuwsgierige, proactieve mindset en de drive om complexe processen steeds slimmer in te richten;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal;

 

Wij bieden

  • Een brutosalaris tussen €5.301 en €7.460 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 40 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Flexibele werktijden voor een goede werk-privébalans;

  • Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze commerciële productstrategie met internationale impact;

  • Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen;

  • Ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatieven binnen een ambitieus team;

  • Dagelijks een heerlijke lunch in bedrijfsrestaurant Steely’s;

  • Uitstekende doorgroeimogelijkheden en ontwikkelkansen.

Ben jij dé Senior Product Manager MRP die we zoeken? Solliciteer dan nu en bouw mee aan onze producten! Wil jij eerst meer weten over de functie of Voortman Steel Machinery, neem dan contact op met Guus Regelink via ----- of bel/WhatsApp naar 0626393850. Twijfel je of jouw achtergrond aansluit bij de functie? Laat het dan vooral weten. Er is vaak meer mogelijk dan je denkt!

jobs.description:
Über QESTIT

QESTIT ist ein auf Qualitätssicherung spezialisiertes Beratungsunternehmen mit Fokus auf Testmanagement und Organisationsberatung entlang des gesamten Software Development Lifecycle, SAP und Non-SAP, mit und ohne KI. Als Teil der international aufgestellten QESTIT Group sind wir in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz, Schweden, Frankreich und Ägypten tätig. In Deutschland arbeiten wir aus Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Köln, Görlitz und München.

Deine Rolle

Wir entwickeln uns weiter: vom operativen Testmanagement hin zur Organisations- und Prozessberatung rund um die Qualitätssicherung im gesamten SDLC. Testing bleibt dabei unser Kern. Unsere Beraterinnen und Berater arbeiten meist allein oder in kleinen Teams direkt beim Kunden. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Als Engagement Lead verantwortest du die Ergebnisse und die Kundenzufriedenheit ausgewählter Accounts im DACH-Raum. Du setzt neue Kundensituationen methodisch auf, steuerst laufende Vorhaben als Projektleitung, auch wenn der Kunde diese Rolle nicht separat beauftragt, und baust die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden gezielt aus. Deine Rolle ist an Accounts und Projekten ausgerichtet, nicht an einer Region.

Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung und bist Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung der QESTIT GmbH. Du führst fachlich, die disziplinarische Führung liegt bei unseren Delivery-Center-Leitungen, mit denen du eng und auf Augenhöhe zusammenarbeitest. Perspektivisch kann die Rolle um disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung wachsen.

Deine Aufgaben

Projekte und Accounts steuern

  • Du übernimmst für deine Bestandskunden die Projektleitung und steuerst Scope, Budget, Timeline und Risiken im Rahmen der Projektverträge

  • Du setzt neue Kundensituationen methodisch auf: Zielbild, Vorgehen (klassisch, agil oder hybrid) und Team-Setup

  • Du legst das methodische Vorgehen in deinen Projekten fest und gibst den Teams die Richtung bei der Erarbeitung der Ergebnisse gemeinsam mit dem Kunden vor

  • Du sicherst die Qualität zentraler Liefergegenstände, bevor sie an den Kunden gehen, und gibst sie frei

Team anleiten und Standards setzen

  • Du leitest unsere Beraterinnen und Berater fachlich und methodisch an und coachst sie in ihren Einsätzen

  • Du meldest Staffing-Bedarfe für deine Accounts an und entscheidest bei der Besetzung deiner Projekte maßgeblich mit

  • Du entwickelst Standards, Playbooks und Templates und sorgst für einheitliche Qualitätsstandards über deine Projekte hinweg

Kunden entwickeln und transparent berichten

  • Du erkennst Wachstumspotenzial in deinen Accounts und hebst es gemeinsam mit unserem Sales-Team

  • Du gestaltest Angebote für deine Accounts aktiv mit

  • Du berichtest der Geschäftsführung regelmäßig über den Status deiner Accounts

  • Du sprichst Risiken früh und offen an und eskalierst, wenn nötig, gegenüber der Geschäftsführung und gegenüber dem Kunden

Dein Profil

Fachlich

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in Qualitätssicherung, Testmanagement und Beratung mit, idealerweise in einem Beratungsunternehmen

  • Du hast QA-Tiefe über den gesamten SDLC, von der Schnittstelle zum Requirements Engineering bis zur Testprozessreife

  • Du hast Erfahrung im SAP-Testmanagement (SAP Activate, Solution Manager bzw. Focused Build) und ebenso belastbare Erfahrung in Non-SAP-Projekten

  • Du setzt KI in der Qualitätssicherung gezielt ein, etwa bei der Testdatengenerierung oder im autonomen Testen

Methodik und Projektmanagement

  • Du bist in klassischen und agilen Vorgehensmodellen (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) gleichermaßen sicher und wählst situativ, was zur Reife des Kunden passt, in der Praxis meist hybrid

  • Du beherrschst das Handwerk der Projektsteuerung: Scope, Risiken, Budget und Stakeholder

  • Du hast Erfahrung in Organisations- und Prozessberatung und im Change Management, von der Ist-Aufnahme bis zu Zielbild und Roadmap

Persönlich

  • Du führst ohne disziplinarische Linie: Du coachst, moderierst Konflikte und gibst Struktur

  • Du trittst souverän auf Entscheiderebene auf und hast ein unternehmerisches Gespür für Potenziale im laufenden Projekt

  • Du kommunizierst klar und ehrlich, auch wenn die Nachricht unbequem ist

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und sehr gut Englisch

  • Du bist bereit, im DACH-Raum zu unseren Kunden zu reisen

Von Vorteil

  • Zertifizierungen wie PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 oder SAFe; sie sind für uns ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Kunden in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Eine neu geschaffene Schlüsselrolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst, wie wir Beratung bei QESTIT liefern

  • Ein internationales Umfeld mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen in sechs Ländern

Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations. We’re looking for a Product Designer to set the cross-application UX direction for our commercial software - from pharma cold-chain visibility that helps temperature-sensitive medicines move safely around the world, to ULD tracking for airlines. You’ll define a consistent, high-quality experience across our modules and applications and support our specialised designers in bringing that experience to life, while remaining hands-on in discovery, from the first user conversation through to the final UX.

📍 Location: We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with remote working available within these countries. Hybrid option available in the Netherlands.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell?

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do:

A dedicated framework team owns our Design System and Design Guidelines, while embedded designers craft the screens and flows within each product module. Your role is to set the overall direction for the experience they design towards — including experience principles, end-to-end journeys and measurable outcomes that help multiple modules feel like one product.

You will:

  • Lead discovery end-to-end, including user research and interviews, journey mapping, jobs-to-be-done, pain points and opportunities, and translate research into a shared foundation for UX and product decisions

  • Create wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes hands-on using Figma and/or code to explore and test concepts during discovery, and run evaluative tests with users and engineers

  • Define the cross-application UX vision, design principles and success metrics together with Product and Marketing

  • Support and align our specialised designers - framework and embedded - around a consistent experience across modules and applications

  • Communicate UX principles and investment priorities to senior leadership, demonstrating the value and potential impact of UX-related roadmap items

jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be.

We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Set the product direction for the Carwow consumer app, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with consumers: interviews, usage data, behavioural analysis, to build a precise understanding of where the app can add the most value

    • Identify, prototype and ship opportunities to bring AI into the app: smarter discovery, personalisation and recommendations that actually change behaviour

    • Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Designer and Engineers as a product trio to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives engagement, retention and revenue, not just activity

  • Design & Engineering Partnership:

    • Work shoulder to shoulder with design to shape journeys and screens from the ground up, and test them with users before engineering starts

    • Work with engineers on the right trade-offs for a native app: release cadence, quality and what to build versus reuse

    • Use AI tools every day in your own work, prototyping, synthesising research and analysing data, so the squad learns faster and ships more

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, data, CRM and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Own the app's success measures and bring clean evidence, including holdouts and controlled tests, to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including time owning a consumer mobile app, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

  • AI-native: you use AI tools daily, you have shipped or prototyped AI-powered features, and you have a clear point of view on where it adds real value for consumers

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve as evidence comes in

  • A proven partnership with design and engineering: you have worked as a product trio and can hold a credible conversation about journeys, architecture and app quality

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

jobs.title: Enterprise Success Manager, NL (EMEA)
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an Enterprise Success Manager at Mistral, you own what happens to our most strategic enterprise accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows, keep production ARR healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams create high-value AI use cases with our customers. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, measuring its business impact, and scaling value across the organization. You will work with customer sponsors, business teams, IT and security stakeholders, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them):

  • Adoption track — embedded in flagship transformations while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the measurement that proves value is landing.

  • Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout, a motion already credited in a major European win.

What You Will Do


Own the customer success and value plan

  • Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

  • Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

  • Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

  • Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

  • Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

  • Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

  • Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

  • Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

  • Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

  • Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

  • Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

  • Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

  • Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

  • Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

  • Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

  • Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

  • Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

  • Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, such as Customer Success, Delivery/Implementation, or Solutions Consulting, ideally in a technical AI or SaaS environment.

  • Experience owning outcomes for enterprise customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

  • Strong technical fluency in enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premises, VPC, serverless) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and security reviews, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity.

  • Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security teams, while translating technical trade-offs into clear business implications for executives and users. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert.

  • Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion.

  • Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability.

  • Fluent English; professional French strongly preferred (a significant share of our enterprise base is French-speaking).

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

  • Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation.

  • Experience building adoption, change-management or customer education programs across large organizations.

  • Experience at a forward-deployed, solutions-led company.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.
