jobs.title: Senior AI Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As a Senior AI Deployment Strategist, you will bridge the gap between vision and execution, ensuring our customers not only see the potential of AI but realize its value in their operations. This role is a unique blend of strategic advisory and hands-on deployment leadership, spanning both presales and postsales phases. You will act as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, architecting AI solutions that drive transformation and delivering measurable business outcomes.

 

You will be embedded in our most strategic accounts, diagnosing business challenges, designing AI-powered solutions, and leading their deployment from concept to full-scale adoption. This role demands a rare combination of executive presence, technical credibility, and commercial acumen, with a focus on both winning and delivering high-impact AI initiatives.

 

What You Will Do

 

Strategic Advisory & C-Suite Partnership

• Serve as the lead strategic advisor for a portfolio of high-value enterprise clients, building trusted relationships with executive leadership (CEO, CTO, CIO).

• Lead C-suite workshops to diagnose business drivers and co-create multi-year AI transformation roadmaps aligned with corporate strategy.

• Develop and present compelling business cases and proposals, articulating the ROI of AI adoption and the value of Mistral’s platform.

 

Presales: Shaping the Vision

• Partner with sales and product teams to identify and qualify opportunities, positioning Mistral’s solutions as the catalyst for enterprise transformation.

• Design tailored AI strategies and proof-of-concepts that address critical business challenges and demonstrate tangible value.

• Act as a subject matter expert in client engagements, ensuring our solutions are understood, trusted, and adopted.

 

Postsales: Driving Deployment & Adoption

• Own the end-to-end success of AI deployments, from strategic planning to operational integration, ensuring solutions are embedded into the customer’s core workflows.

• Lead cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, and product managers to execute deployment roadmaps and deliver measurable results.

• Navigate organizational complexity and drive change management to ensure seamless adoption and long-term success.

 

Commercial Growth & Thought Leadership

• Identify and cultivate expansion opportunities within accounts, connecting Mistral’s capabilities to new business challenges and driving commercial growth.

• Mentor junior strategists and contribute to the development of best practices, methodologies, and playbooks for customer engagement.

• Represent Mistral AI as a thought leader through speaking engagements, executive briefings, and industry contributions.

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

• You have 8+ years of experience in technical management consulting, enterprise technology, or a customer-facing strategic role, with a focus on AI/ML, data architecture, or digital transformation.

• You hold a degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, etc.)

• You possess a deep, practical expertise in AI/ML concepts, enterprise data architecture, and modern software development with hands-on development of AI solutions—enough to credibly engage with technical teams and executives alike.

• You have a proven track record of engaging and influencing C-suite executives, with the ability to navigate complex conversations and align AI strategies with business objectives.

• You excel at structuring ambiguous problems into actionable programs and thrive in fast-paced, high-stakes environments.

• You are equally comfortable in presales and postsales: shaping deals, designing solutions, and ensuring their successful deployment.

• You have experience managing high-value accounts, understanding deal mechanics, and building compelling cases for investment.

• You are a collaborative leader who can motivate cross-functional teams and drive results through influence, not authority.

 

We are looking for adaptable, low-ego team players who are passionate about turning AI vision into reality and delivering transformative impact for our customers.

 

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview 

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Role: QA Automation Lead

Location: London, Bristol

Level: C3

Team: Quality

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Senior QA Manager

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

The QA Automation Leads are part of a leadership team and they work closely with QA Leads and Staff Engineers to enable Development Engineers to test the code that they produce.

The QA Automation Leads will be an authority on test data creation, test tools, and test automation best practice. They will coach Engineers through test automation, provision tools, and automate controls to ensure the quality of code delivered to client-facing teams and clients.

They will work with the Quality Enablement Team to embed automation frameworks, as well as automation that will audit AI generated code and tests. They will be the conduit between Engineering teams using these tools and the Enablement Team.

The QA Automation Leads will support QA professionals in the Forward Deployed Engineering Teams in the creation and validation of End to End tests that involve their domains.

 

  • Coach and enable development engineers to write automated tests at service and domain level, and to test their own products and solutions.

  • Provide the tooling for creating test data, building test automation and reporting test results.

  • Partner with QA and development engineers in Forward Deployed Engineering teams to define and implement automated handovers between teams, and support their end-to-end testing.

  • Implement innovative automation of testing, defect management and release processes for Global Product Teams, using AI where it adds value.

  • Work with the Enablement Team to build intelligent automated testing solutions (such as testing the tests) and roll them out.

  • Use AI tools and techniques to build, refine and scale internal testing tools and frameworks, and build AI-driven tools that remove bottlenecks in code and architecture and speed up test-and-deploy cycles.

  • Lead by example as a technical leader: champion best practice in test automation, AI code validation and agent tooling, write clean, testable code, perform code reviews and mentor mid-level and junior engineers.


What you’ll bring

  • Experience building, maintaining and enhancing test automation frameworks, using tools and languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Playwright or Cypress.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals (design patterns, API design, data structures) in Python, TypeScript or similar, with experience automating tests using APIs.

  • Knowledge of improving test data management, users and scenarios for ease of testing, and of working with developers to review automated unit and integration tests.

  • Previous management experience, leading and coaching engineers across test cases

  • A solid understanding of the SDLC, Agile methology and QA process.

  • Experience using AI tools, such as LLM-based coding assistants and agent frameworks, as part of a pipeline, along with an understanding of prompt engineering and LLM evaluation techniques (faithfulness, relevance, LLM-as-a-judge), since traditional pass/fail assertions don’t translate well to AI agent testing.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and to collaborate with multiple stakeholders towards a common goal.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a solution-oriented mindset, with the willingness to speak up, highlight areas for improvement and suggest solutions.

Nice to have

  • Experience building or integrating AI agents, such as LangChain, AutoGen, custom agent frameworks or MCP-based tooling.

  • Experience working with or testing AI-generated code, models or agents, covering both deterministic validation (is the generated code correct?) and non-deterministic evaluation (is the AI’s behaviour acceptable?).

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows.

  • Knowledgade of Jira and test management tools such as XRay.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. For software engineering organizations, this means helping customers adopt Codex and other OpenAI capabilities across the software development lifecycle—transforming how teams plan, build, test, review, and deliver software.

We work directly with engineering leaders and hands-on developers to identify high-value opportunities, design and implement AI-powered development workflows, and scale what works across engineering organizations. As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex, you will partner directly with leading engineering organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that transform how software is developed. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from workflow and use-case selection through prototyping, evaluation, production rollout, and scaled adoption.

You will work alongside engineering teams to build advanced AI coding workflows, integrations, automations, and evaluation systems—often using Codex itself as part of your development process. You will help customers make technical decisions involving model behavior, agentic workflows, developer environments, security, reliability, evaluation, and operational readiness, while ensuring deployments translate into measurable improvements in engineering productivity and software delivery.

You will work closely with OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, Sales, and the broader Codex organization, translating real-world deployment experience into high-signal product and model feedback. In this role, you will:

  • Influence customer engineering strategy by helping technical leaders understand how AI coding systems can reshape their software development lifecycle, engineering practices, and organizational workflows.

Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition at Polarsteps - Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

Over the past 10+ years, Polarsteps has grown massively through word-of-mouth, thanks to our product and tech department building a top-quality user experience for all our travelers.

As our first Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, you'll own the foundation that every data-driven decision at Polarsteps is built on. Product & growth teams run experiments and analyse the data every week, leadership need clear reports for investors, and all of that depends on data that is reliable, modelled and compliant. You'll set the direction for our data platform, bring structure to data governance, and own the data infra that helps our product managers, marketers and data scientists do their job even better. You'll work closely with the Head of Engineering on infrastructure and architecture, and with the Head of Growth and product teams on what the business needs from data.

With 20M+ users and ratings of 4.8 and 4.7 on the app stores and features in multiple Google and Apple showcases, we've got an impressive past. But we're even more excited for the future, and you'll play a crucial role in building the data foundation that gets Polarsteps to 100M+ travelers around the globe.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

  • Own the data platform roadmap: set the strategy for our data infrastructure and warehouse, make the build-vs-buy and tooling calls, and oversee execution together with DevOps.

  • Design, build and maintain scalable ingestion pipelines for both internal (product events, back-end data) and external sources (ad platforms, attribution, app store data).

  • Build and maintain a clean, documented modeling layer (e.g. dbt) that serves as the single source of truth for analysts, data scientists and self-serving PMs.

  • Lead data governance: define and enforce event naming and tracking standards, a schema change process, documentation, and dashboard ownership.

  • Embed privacy in the data stack: make sure personal data is categorized, minimized and pseudonymized before it reaches downstream and third-party tools, in close collaboration with Legal

  • Own the health of the stack: monitoring, alerting, data quality checks and cost management, so issues are caught before they reach stakeholders.

  • Define who owns what across our data tooling (e.g. Mixpanel, our warehouse and BI layer), and help teams get the most out of self-serve analytics.

  • Enable data enrichment to unlock deeper insights for Product and Growth.

  • Explore how we can safely use LLMs (such as Claude) on top of our data for analysis and reporting.

  • Act as the go-to data partner for Product, Engineering and Growth, and help grow the data function as Polarsteps scales.

The equipment in your backpack

What we're hoping you'll bring with you.

✅ 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a hybrid data role, ideally in a B2C product or mobile app company.

✅ Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on experience modeling large event datasets in a modern warehouse (e.g. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

✅ Experience with dbt and an orchestration tool such as Airflow or Dagster.

✅ Proven track record of bringing structure to data governance: tracking plans, event ownership, documentation and data quality.

✅ Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Amplitude) and BI tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker).

✅ Comfortable owning infrastructure decisions: cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD for data.

✅ A pragmatic, ownership-driven mindset: you're happy to set the strategy and get your hands dirty, and you enjoy the hygiene work others tend to avoid.

✅ Excellent communication skills: you can explain trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders alike.

Bonus points if you have:

✨ Experience with mobile attribution or marketing data (e.g. AppsFlyer, SKAdNetwork, ad platform APIs).

✨ Experience with reverse ETL or CDPs (e.g. RudderStack, Twilio Segment).

✨ Experience with experimentation data and A/B testing infrastructure.

✨ Knowledge of GDPR and handling personal data responsibly in an analytics stack.

1st class Polarsteps extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d) - AI healthtech
jobs.description:
🎤 Why voize? Because we're more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload. We combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact!

💡 Your Mission

As a Senior Product Designer at voize, you’ll work at the intersection of AI, healthcare, and human-centered design, creating products that make a real difference in the daily work of healthcare professionals.

You’ll translate complex, high-stakes care workflows into intuitive mobile experiences that reduce cognitive load for nurses and measurably save time where it matters most.

What makes this role unique is the level of ownership and impact. You’ll work in small, highly collaborative product teams where design decisions meaningfully shape product direction. From discovery through rollout, you’ll stay hands-on through implementation and iteration, shipping work that is not just thoughtful, but truly impactful!

🚀 Your Daily Business

You’ll work close to the realities of frontline care. This means spending time with users, understanding real workflows, and turning complex, messy situations into clear, usable product experiences.

  • Own a core product area. Shape and evolve its design direction over time.

  • Design the full flow, not individual screens. Map end-to-end journeys, prototype interactions, and craft production-ready UI that holds up in high-pressure environments.

  • Go where the work happens. Join on-site visits and user sessions, watch real workflows, and capture the constraints that never show up in specs.

  • Obsess over users, drive adoption. Design for diverse user groups with varying levels of tech comfort, and understand how your work drives adoption.

  • Turn insight into direction. Synthesize research into clear problem statements, hypotheses, and UX principles the team can rally around.

  • Balance speed and quality. Use AI-assisted workflows and tools to accelerate exploration and prototyping without compromising craft or usability.

  • Be a partner to Product and Engineering. Make trade-offs explicit, unblock decisions, and stay close through implementation so what ships matches what was intended.

  • Drive consistency through shared solutions. Work with a Senior Product Designer on cross-product problems, patterns, and reusable solutions.

🤝 Your Skillset

You not only bring ownership, craft, and user obsession - but also bring great aesthetic taste & strong design instincts.

  • You have designed mobile-first product experiences end-to-end, ideally in Healthcare, SaaS or mobile workflow tools and can walk through the messy parts: what you learned, what you changed, and what impact it had.

  • You have contributed to a large design initiative (e.g. a product redesign) and helped drive it toward measurable success.

  • You are strong in interaction design and visual craft and sweat the details.

  • You are fluent in Figma and comfortable using modern AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and prototyping

  • You communicate design intent in a way engineers & product managers can implement without guesswork.

  • You understand mobile design patterns (Android + iOS) and can simplify complex, real-world workflows for users who are not tech-native.

  • You operate well in ambiguity: you ask the right questions, make pragmatic trade-offs, and keep quality high.

  • You bring the human side: empathy, direct communication, and high accountability.

  • You are fluent in English

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people.

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany.

  • You become a co-creator of our success with stock options.

  • You get generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses.

  • You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.

✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀

We’re looking for Product Designers with great aesthetic taste & instincts, who thrive in ambiguity, love getting close to users, and want their work to show up in the real world.

You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Your skills and experience will stand out & set you apart - especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. voize welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

We're excited to hear from you!

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - UKI/Nordics (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Account Executive (m/f/x) (English Speaking) 

Location: EU 

(Remote) 

Comp: 120k EUR base 

Territories: UKI/Nordics 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Account Executives who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

 

  • Own and grow a defined territory of named enterprise accounts across UKI/Nordics. 

  • Take commercial ownership of the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new opportunities through to negotiation, closing and account expansion. 

  • Deliver an individual annual revenue target of €1.1M once ramped, driving new business acquisition and growth within existing accounts. 

  • Build and develop a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities, supported by SDRs and strategic partners. 

  • Lead complex enterprise sales engagements, typically involving deal values of €150K–€300K, multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles. 

  • Develop strategic relationships with enterprise customers, technology partners and consulting firms to drive commercial opportunities. 

  • Position and sell complex, data-driven SaaS solutions to large enterprise organisations, translating technical capabilities into measurable business value. 

  • Support the introduction and commercialisation of new products, helping establish market presence and identify new growth opportunities. 


  • Strong preference for candidates who have verbal and written communication skills in a native language in the Nordics. 

  • Proven ability to sell complex, high-value SaaS solutions into large enterprise organisations, managing long sales cycles and significant deal values. 

  • Ability to develop territory strategies, build account plans and identify opportunities for new business acquisition and account expansion. 

  • Strong hunting mentality with the ability to independently identify, engage and convert new enterprise prospects. 

  • Skilled in navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes, coordinating internal and external teams and managing sophisticated commercial negotiations. 

  • Ability to understand complex customer challenges, conduct effective discovery and position solutions around business outcomes rather than product features. 

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to build business cases, demonstrate ROI and communicate the financial and operational value of technology investments. 

  • Experience working alongside technology, consulting and implementation partners to develop opportunities and close enterprise deals. 

  • Ability to understand and communicate complex data-driven technology, analytics, software and technical solutions to both technical and business stakeholders. 

  • Practical experience applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or similar enterprise sales frameworks. 

  • Ability to prioritise named accounts, identify whitespace opportunities and develop strategic approaches to maximise territory revenue. 

  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to manage commercial objections, procurement processes and executive-level discussions. 

  • Comfortable operating in a changing environment, launching new products and navigating ambiguity. 

  • Proficiency with modern sales tools, including HubSpot, Microsoft Office 365 and pipeline forecasting platforms. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior executives and technical decision-makers. 

  • Nice to have: experience selling services. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

  

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

jobs.title: Programmatic Advertising Specialist - BENELUX
jobs.description:
Programmatic Advertising Specialist (Dutch Speaking)

Publisher Success | Amsterdam, Netherlands (Onsite) | Full Time | Permanent

About Refinery89



Refinery89 is a Dutch AdTech company headquartered in Madrid, working with premium publishers worldwide to optimize programmatic advertising performance.

Through advanced, data-driven technology, we help publishers maximize advertising revenue, improve monetization efficiency, and gain greater transparency across their advertising operations.

Our international team brings together specialists in programmatic advertising, publisher monetization, technology, and account management to deliver measurable results for our partners.

About the Role



Are you currently working in Programmatic Advertising, Ad Operations, Campaign Management, or Publisher Monetization and looking to take the next step in your career?

We're looking for a Dutch-speaking Programmatic Advertising Specialist to join our Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with a solid understanding of digital advertising who wants to move beyond campaign execution and take on a more strategic, publisher-facing role.

You don't need previous Account Management experience. We're particularly interested in candidates who understand the programmatic advertising ecosystem, enjoy analyzing performance, solving technical challenges, and communicating with clients.

You'll work directly with Dutch publishers, helping them optimize their advertising performance, maximize revenue, and develop long-term partnerships with Refinery89.

You'll collaborate closely with our Technical Account Managers, AdTech specialists, Product, and Sales teams to deliver the best possible experience for our publishing partners.

Key Responsibilities



Publisher Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers in the Netherlands.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for publisher inquiries, performance discussions, and ongoing support.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each publisher's business needs and monetization objectives.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and problem-solving.


Programmatic Performance & Revenue Optimization

  • Monitor and analyze advertising performance, including revenue, eCPM, fill rates, and other relevant programmatic metrics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve publisher monetization and overall advertising performance.
  • Translate advertising data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with technical specialists to implement and evaluate optimization initiatives.


Technical Coordination & Troubleshooting

  • Help publishers identify and resolve advertising-related issues.
  • Work closely with internal AdTech and Technical Account Management teams to investigate technical challenges.
  • Coordinate solutions and ensure publishers receive timely updates.
  • Develop a strong understanding of Refinery89's advertising technology and monetization solutions.


Strategic Growth & Publisher Success

  • Identify opportunities to grow existing publisher accounts.
  • Support publisher performance reviews and strategic discussions.
  • Share insights about market trends, advertising technologies, and monetization opportunities.
  • Contribute to long-term publisher satisfaction, retention, and growth.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Publisher Sales, Technical Account Managers, AdTech, Product, and Finance teams.
  • Communicate publisher feedback and market insights internally.
  • Help improve processes, workflows, and the overall publisher experience.


What We're Looking For



Must-Have Qualifications

  • Native-level Dutch proficiency, with professional working proficiency in English.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience in programmatic advertising, AdTech, digital advertising, campaign management, or publisher operations.
  • Familiarity with the programmatic advertising ecosystem, including technologies such as Google Ad Manager, SSPs, DSPs, or ad exchanges.
  • Comfortable working with advertising performance data, reports, and dashboards.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interest in working directly with publishers and developing long-term business relationships.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Google Ad Manager or other advertising platforms.
  • Knowledge of header bidding, Prebid.js, or publisher monetization strategies.
  • Previous experience working with publishers, media owners, or advertising technology companies.
  • Experience in campaign optimization, yield management, or programmatic trading.
  • Previous client-facing or Account Management experience.


Previous Account Management experience is NOT required.

Who Should Apply?



We encourage applications from professionals currently working in roles such as:

  • Programmatic Advertising Specialist
  • Programmatic Trader
  • Ad Operations Specialist
  • Campaign Manager (Programmatic)
  • Publisher Operations Specialist
  • Yield Optimization Specialist
  • Digital Advertising Specialist
  • Technical Account Specialist (AdTech)


If you have a technical understanding of digital advertising and want to develop your career in publisher relationship management, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Join Refinery89?

  • Work at a growing international AdTech company with Dutch roots.
  • Develop expertise in publisher monetization and programmatic advertising.
  • Transition into a more strategic, client-facing position while building on your existing technical knowledge.
  • Collaborate with experienced AdTech professionals across multiple departments.
  • Gain exposure to premium publishers and advanced advertising technologies.
  • Build your career in a dynamic and rapidly evolving industry.


Interview Process



Our recruitment process consists of four stages:

  1. Initial Screening: Introductory call with our Talent Acquisition team.
  2. First Interview: Video interview with members of the Publisher Success team.
  3. Second Interview: Interview with the Hiring Manager and/or senior stakeholders.
  4. Final Interview: In-person meeting with the Hiring Manager and key team members (location to be confirmed).


Ready to Take the Next Step?



Whether you're currently managing advertising campaigns, optimizing programmatic performance, or supporting publisher monetization, this could be your opportunity to take on greater responsibility and develop your career in AdTech.

Apply today and join Refinery89's Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

Je komt terecht in een professionele IT-omgeving waarin verschillende teams samenwerken aan generieke IT-diensten rondom monitoring, logging, configuratiemanagement en analytics. Deze diensten worden breed ingezet en zijn belangrijk voor stabiele en veilige dienstverlening.

Als Medior Solution Architect ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, afstemmen en verder ontwikkelen van IT-oplossingen. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met product owners, architecten, DevOps-teams en andere stakeholders.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

Je hebt minimaal HBO werk- en denkniveau en een relevante studie afgerond in  de richting van ICT.   • Een salaris tussen € 3000 en € 3500 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive Public Sector (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Client Executive Public Sector Germany (m/f/d), you will be responsible for driving the growth and expansion of our business within the German public sector. You will acquire new clients, develop strategic relationships, and lead complex sales opportunities from initial engagement through to contract signature. Working closely with internal experts, you will shape our market strategy and create the foundation for sustainable growth in the German public sector.

Business Development Public Sector

  • Develop and execute the sales and go-to-market strategy to drive sustainable growth of our public sector business in Germany.

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop target customers, market opportunities, and strategic accounts while building a long-term sales pipeline.

  • Analyze market, technology, and regulatory trends and derive targeted sales initiatives in collaboration with marketing, partners, and internal experts.

Strategic Account & Client Management

  • Build and expand strategic client relationships and develop long-term partnerships.

  • Establish trusted relationships with stakeholders across business, IT, procurement, and executive levels while understanding decision-making structures.

  • Develop and execute account plans and drive cross-sell, upsell, and growth opportunities by positioning our service and solution portfolio.

Network Development

  • Build and maintain a strong network of public sector stakeholders, decision-makers, partners, and industry influencers.

  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking forums to strengthen market presence and expand market access.

  • Leverage structured stakeholder management to identify new opportunities, strategic initiatives, and future business potential at an early stage.

Opportunity Development & Sales Ownership

  • Identify, qualify, and strategically develop complex sales opportunities with clear deal, win, and closing strategies.

  • Own opportunities end-to-end across the entire sales cycle, from needs assessment through contract award.

  • Manage pipeline, forecasting, and closing activities, including risk, stakeholder, and decision-management processes.

Public Procurement & Tender Management

  • Identify, assess, and strategically manage public tenders, procurement procedures, and framework agreements.

  • Develop winning bid, positioning, and partnering strategies in collaboration with Bid Management, Solution Experts, and external partners.

  • Ensure strong competitive positioning through differentiation, negotiation, and effective management of procurement opportunities.

Consultative & Value Selling

  • Analyze the strategic, organizational, and technological requirements of public sector clients and translate them into business and transformation opportunities.

  • Develop and position compelling value propositions that connect business value, technical solutions, and commercial models.

  • Lead executive-level customer engagements and communicate effectively with business leaders, CIO organizations, procurement teams, and management.

  • Own the commercial deal and negotiation strategy to achieve successful business outcomes.


  • Several years of successful experience in B2B and/or B2G sales

  • Ideally 7+ years of relevant professional experience in Enterprise Sales, Account Management, Business Development, or comparable roles

  • Several years of experience within the German public sector

  • Proven track record in building and developing strategic customer relationships

  • Demonstrated success in managing complex and long-term sales cycles

  • Ideally experience in the SAP and/or ERP environment, or with cloud and software solutions

  • Experience with public tenders, procurement procedures, and bidding processes

  • Strong understanding of the German public-sector market, including the structures and decision-making processes of public-sector organizations and authorities.

If you think that you don't meet all the requirements: With us, there are "no limits" to your development! Go your way with us - we support you! Just show us who you are.

What you can expect from us:

An environment that is always open to change and optimization. There is no "it's always been like this" with us. You have the opportunity to contribute your knowledge, design processes, standardize existing topics or optimize workflows. Be a source of inspiration and bring us even further forward with your expertise!

We create conditions in which you feel comfortable:

  • Home office contracts & absolute flexibility through free organization of working hours

  • Permanent position and 30 days of vacation

  • FlexWork: Work remotely from other European countries for up to 3 months per year

  • Monthly budget for individually selectable benefits from over 50 possible offers via emplu, various offers via corporate benefits, as well as bicycle and car leasing via salary conversion

  • Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 10 free sessions with psychologists annually as well as access to meditations and courses

  • We provide you with targeted support in your professional and personal development at Natuvion

  • Mentoring program for a structured and personal induction

  • Be part of the #teamgreen - At Natuvion, you'll work on innovative projects as part of a team that stands up for each other. We rely on cooperation, openness and trust

  • Modern equipment and central offices in Walldorf, Berlin, Munich and Leipzig

  • Your long-term perspective is important to us, which is why we subsidize your company pension scheme as well as capital-forming benefits

Join #teamgreen - Natuvion is a digital moving company.

Our team does not move tables, filing cabinets or chairs. Natuvion transports business-critical data and processes from one technology platform to another. jobs.title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system.


What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d):

German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result.

You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.


  • Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably.

  • Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design.

  • Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.

  • Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs.

  • Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate.

How we work:

  • AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production.

  • Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence.

  • Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital.

  • Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints.

  • Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships.

  • Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog.

  • Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage.


What we’re looking for:

  • Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team.

  • Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count.

  • Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes.

  • Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code.

  • Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required.

  • Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team.

  • Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval and source attribution; healthcare data standards such as FHIR; regulation such as MDR and the EU AI Act.

What we offer

  • Growth: we invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership or exploring new AI approaches, supported by a dedicated learning and development budget and regular feedback. If you grow, we grow.

  • Purposeful work: your work has a real impact on patients, their families and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture: flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty and recognition. English is our working language across a team of 20+ nationalities.

jobs.description:
Möchtest du den Arbeitsalltag von Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Frankreich und Europa aktiv mitgestalten?

Fühlst du dich in einem vertrauensvollen und dynamischen Umfeld wohl?

Dann könnte Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich sein, und du könntest perfekt zu dieser Rolle passen 🙂

Unsere Vision

Wir möchten das beliebteste Financial Operating System für europäische KMU werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmer:innen, den zeitaufwendigen Aufwand rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu reduzieren. Gleichzeitig erhalten sie Zugang zu wichtigen Informationen, die sie dabei unterstützen, bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Auch Steuerkanzleien profitieren davon. Mit Pennylane können sie manuelle und repetitive Aufgaben reduzieren und mehr Zeit in die Beratung und Begleitung ihrer Mandant:innen investieren.

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintech-Unternehmen in Frankreich, und wir beschleunigen derzeit unser Wachstum in Deutschland 🇩🇪

Seit unserer Gründung vor sechs Jahren ist es uns gelungen:

💻 Uns als wegweisende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerkanzleien zu etablieren

💰 Insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro aufzunehmen, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem bekannten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe und PayPal investiert hat

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Von sieben Gründer:innen auf mehr als 1.200 Mitarbeitende zu wachsen. Heute gelten wir als einer der besten Arbeitgeber in Frankreich und bieten zudem zahlreiche Remote-Arbeitsmöglichkeiten. Auf Glassdoor haben wir eine Bewertung von 4,6/5.

🌍 Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten und einer stark remote-freundlichen Kultur aufzubauen. Bereits 30 % unserer Mitarbeitenden arbeiten von verschiedenen Orten in Europa aus.

🤝 Das Vertrauen von Tausenden Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien zu gewinnen und hervorragende Bewertungen zu erhalten

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1,3 Millionen kleine und mittlere Unternehmen sowie über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien in Frankreich dabei zu unterstützen, Pennylane zu nutzen

Über die Rolle

Du möchtest mehr tun, als nur offene Stellen zu besetzen? Du möchtest dabei helfen, ein Team aufzubauen und das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland mitzugestalten?

Deutschland ist unser Startup im Startup: Wir sind seit rund einem Jahr auf dem Markt, haben etwa 40 Mitarbeitende und ambitionierte Pläne für 2027. Dafür suchen wir dich, eine erfahrene Person im Business Recruiting mit Drive, klarer Haltung und Lust, etwas von Grund auf aufzubauen.

Du wirst Teil unseres deutschen Recruiting-Teams, das derzeit aus einer Teamleiterin und zwei Freelance-Recruiter:innen besteht. In dieser Festanstellung als Individual Contributor übernimmst du deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und gestaltest mit, wie wir in Deutschland Talente gewinnen und einstellen.

Dein Beitrag

  • Verantworte deinen eigenen Bereich: Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess, vom Briefing und proaktiven Sourcing bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Sales, Customer Success, Partner Success, Onboarding und Deployment. Je nach Business-Bedarf unterstützt du auch die Bereiche Marketing, People und weitere Support-Funktionen.

  • Sei Sparringspartner:in: Du verstehst die Ziele deiner Hiring Manager:innen, bringst wertvolle Marktkenntnisse ein und hinterfragst Erwartungen konstruktiv. Gemeinsam trefft ihr fundiertere Einstellungsentscheidungen.

  • Aufbauen, testen und verbessern: Du entwickelst unsere Prozesse und Interviewstrukturen weiter, probierst neue Ansätze aus und machst aus guten Ideen funktionierende Lösungen.

  • Verbinde Geschwindigkeit mit Qualität: Du priorisierst deine Recruiting-Aktivitäten auf Grundlage der Business-Anforderungen und Pipeline-Daten. Gleichzeitig stellst du sicher, dass sich Kandidat:innen während des gesamten Prozesses gut informiert und wertgeschätzt fühlen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Idealerweise mehr als fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Full-Cycle-Recruiting, mit einer klaren Spezialisierung auf Business- und Go-to-Market-Rollen sowie Erfahrung in der Besetzung von Sales- und/oder Success-Positionen.

  • Du weißt, wie du Talente proaktiv gewinnst, Recruiting-Prozesse eigenständig steuerst und Hiring Manager:innen berätst, auch dann, wenn ihr nicht sofort einer Meinung seid.

  • Du hast Lust, etwas aufzubauen, statt ein fertiges Playbook abzuarbeiten: Du übernimmst Verantwortung, setzt Ideen in die Tat um und bleibst handlungsfähig, wenn sich Prioritäten ändern. Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up ist ein Plus.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, nutzt Daten und Recruiting-Tools sinnvoll und teilst dein Wissen sowie deine Learnings mit dem Team.

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse: Du führst Interviews sicher in beiden Sprachen und arbeitest souverän mit Stakeholdern auf Deutsch und Englisch zusammen.

Warum diese Rolle?

Weil du hier nicht einfach einen bestehenden Prozess übernimmst. Du hilfst dabei, unser deutsches Team weiter auszubauen, mit einem eigenen Verantwortungsbereich, engem Austausch mit dem Business und Raum für Projekte, die langfristig Wirkung zeigen.

Du hast Lust, anzupacken, Dinge besser zu machen und gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen? Dann lass uns sprechen.

Was wir tun, um deinen Arbeitsalltag zu erleichtern

🏢 Diese Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt und beinhaltet die Präsenz vor Ort an einigen Tagen pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro in der Rosenthaler Straße 43–45.

  • Manager-Interview: Gespräch mit Leona, Business Lead Financial Services & International Hires, 45 bis 60 Minuten per Video-Call

  • Abschlussgespräch: Gespräch mit Ursula Piscitelli, Head of Talent Acquisition, und Marine Bustarret, VP People, 45 bis 60 Minuten per Video-Call

Wir arbeiten schnell und effizient. Insgesamt dauert unser Bewerbungsprozess in der Regel zwischen 15 und 25 Tagen.

Wir haben dir möglichst viele Informationen über den Zweck, die Aufgaben und das Umfeld dieser Position gegeben. Jetzt bist du gefragt: Zeige uns, ob du dich in dieser Position sowohl wohlfühlen als auch einen echten Beitrag zu unserem Unternehmen leisten kannst.

Vielfalt macht uns zu einem besseren und spannenderen Ort zum Arbeiten.

jobs.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

🎯Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant qu’ingénieur(e) de développement, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en formation, recherche et innovation affecté à l’Institut Henri FAYOL. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal.

Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol.

Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. 

📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles.

✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre.

A l’heure actuelle, face aux besoins croissants d’acteurs pour accompagner les transitions des entreprises et de leurs écosystèmes territoriaux et industriels, Mines Saint-Etienne, dans le cadre du projet Phygital financé par la région AURA, a décidé de massifier ses formations i) en s’appuyant sur des pratiques innovantes en direction de publics hétérogènes (formation initiale, formation tout au long de la vie, formation par la recherche), et ii) en se basant sur de nombreux cas d’usages technologiques (Intelligence Artificielle, Sciences des données, Jumeaux Numériques, Gestion de production, etc), démonstrateurs des enjeux actuels de l’industrie et des territoires du futur. Ces cas d’usages technologiques sont développés à ce jour sur ses plateformes informatiques et industrielles du laboratoire des transitions, et doivent être déployés à grande échelle :

 

Dans ce cadre, vos différentes missions sont :

  • Intégrer les nouveaux composants connectés (robots mobiles, bras robotiques, convoyeurs, capteurs et actionneurs divers) et assurer leur fonctionnement avec le reste du matériel, notamment en déployant des interfaces interactives pour faciliter leur utilisation.

  • Aider à la conception de contenu pédagogique de douze modules définis comme prioritaire dans ce projet Phygital (Optimisation de systèmes de production, Instrumentation responsable pour le pilotage du territoire et de l’industrie, Système Information pour l’observation et le pilotage d’un territoire, Système Information pour le pilotage industrie (PLM/ERP/MES), Détection d'anomalies et maintenance prédictive, Jumeaux Numériques Flux et processus, Robotique de manipulation et de transitique, Assistance numérique opérateur, Cybersécurité, Intégration et ingénierie systèmes intelligents (couplage de différents modules pour constituer un système cyber-physique intelligent multifonction) en lien avec les plateformes et les logiciels développés).

  • Faciliter la maintenance les logiciels et matériels pour l’exploitation des composants connectés.

 

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à faire dialoguer enseignement, recherche et application concrète sera essentielle pour réussir, notamment avec les autres ingénieurs de développement intervenant dans le périmètre du laboratoire des transitions.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de Master (Bac+5) ou équivalent et possédez :

• Une expérience confirmée en conception logicielle et/ou en intégration de systèmes

• Une bonne maîtrise de la programmation (notamment Python, C++ ou Java)

• Connaissances dans les technologies de l’IA

 

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

• Connaissances de l’environnement ROS (Robot Operating System)

• Conception d’interfaces utilisateurs et UX Design

• Collaboration passée avec des enseignants-chercheurs

• Intérêt pour la pédagogie et éventuellement, une expérience en enseignement

• Rigueur, travail en équipe, autonomie, proactivité

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

  • Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

  • Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Pre-Sales role ⭐️

Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers.

Here are the main missions of the team you will join:

  • Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools;

  • Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities;

  • Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts;

  • Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products;

  • Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap;

  • Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings;

  • Eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings leveraging your unique knowledge of the customer’s requirements and specificities.

You will actively participate in developing this growing function within Alan and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most successful of all!

Given the growing need for onsite customer engagement, this role requires you to be based in Paris or the Île-de-France region (or within a 2-hour door to door distance with the flexibility to travel to Paris on short notice for customer meetings).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-E level range.

⭐️ You will be a great fit if ⭐️

  • You have 6+ years of experience working in a SaaS environment, including at least 3 in a Pre-Sales / Sales Engineering / Solution Consultant role.

  • You have a talent for quickly getting to the root cause of customers concern through active listening and requirements elicitation;

  • You are assertive and know how to handle objections in a complex environment;

  • You master the art of pitching a product with transparency and without overselling its capabilities ;

  • You have the ability to break down complex issues and identify product gaps to define the best product solutions;

  • You thrive at high level stakeholders’ management;

  • You excel at prioritizing tasks while living up to commitments;

  • You love teamwork and are always eager to learn and grow;

  • You are fluent in both French and English;

It would be even better if you have:

  • Experience with end-to-end procurement projects (buyer or supplier side) with involvement in RFI’s, RFQ’s and RFP’s;

  • Experience in the French Public Sector;

  • Experience in HRIS ecosystems and Payroll solutions;

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Your decisions here won't get lost in a big system. They'll define it.

As Staff Backend Engineer for Manychat for Brands, you’ll own the technical side of a new product. You’ll set the architecture and technical priorities with the team, and decide what lives in our Python services and what stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. It’s an individual contributor role with a lot of room to make an impact.

The product fills a real gap. Brands pay influencers to post but then can’t see what happens next. We’re building the first view that shows it: who asked for the link, who opened the DM, who clicked, for every campaign, creator and post.

You’ll work with Product as a partner and stay close to brands and creators, so feedback reaches you fast and helps you shape Manychat for Brands.

Sound like you? Let’s talk!

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Engineering team:

We keep Manychat running smoothly under high load every single day and make sure it's ready to scale even further. We do it by combining strong engineering foundations with AI tools that let us move faster without cutting corners. And we're the ones who shape and own what gets built. AI accelerates. Humans own the thinking.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

  • Set the architecture and technical priorities for Brands together with the Engineering Manager and the team: service boundaries, data models, authentication, access control, and integration with the core Manychat platform.

  • Decide which logic belongs in the Python-based Brands services and which stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. Think about data ownership, reliability, and long-term maintenance.

  • Lead big system-level changes when the path isn't clear yet. Explore options, split the work into measurable milestones, and plan data migrations, gradual rollouts, and rollbacks.

  • Define reliability and performance requirements for key Brands workflows. Set metrics and observability, and check the impact of your changes on production data.

  • Find the root causes of slowdowns and repeated incidents across service boundaries, using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

  • Work with Security, Infrastructure, and Platform teams on solutions. Decide what to fix in the application and what needs other teams, and explain the trade-offs clearly.

  • Work with Product on the approach and scope of solutions, and suggest simpler options when you see them.

  • Make technical decisions easy to follow: document key choices and the reasons behind them, do thorough design and code reviews, and share your knowledge in complex areas.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • Deep expertise in Python backend development and a broad view of backend architecture beyond one language. You can understand existing systems, even when the technology is new to you.

  • A strong product mindset. You work closely with Product Managers, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade-offs in terms of user experience, timelines, and product capabilities.

  • Experience owning the architecture and production operations of a product or a large technical area, not only delivering separate features.

  • A solid understanding of distributed systems and data flows: API contracts, async processing, data consistency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.

  • Knowledge of how backend applications are deployed and run in production: configuration, networking, and external dependencies.

  • Knowledge of application security basics: authentication, authorization, data isolation, and access management.

  • Comfort in a fast-changing environment. Things can shift quickly here, and the team relies on everyone's proactivity and ownership.

  • Strong English for technical and product discussions and for documentation.

It would be great if you have:

  • Hands-on PHP experience, on top of understanding how our Python and PHP systems work together.

  • Experience with ETL/DWH pipelines and analytics systems.

  • Experience with environment configuration, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Experience improving AI-assisted software development practices.

Our tech stack: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery. Our services integrate with Manychat's PHP-based platform. Everything runs on AWS and Kubernetes, with Terraform/Terragrunt for infrastructure. You don't need hands-on experience with every tool. Technical depth and the ability to reason about complex systems matter most.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

  • 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family.

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

  • 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster.

Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. We will do our best to provide assistance throughout your interview process to ensure you’re set up for success.
