jobs.description:
Change and Transformation Manager – Client Delivery (French/english)

Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office; occasional travel to Brussels and London)
Level: Programme Manager senior
Team: Client Delivery
Contract: Permanent
Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead

Please note: This role is based in France, so you need to live here or be open to relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own change and transformation support for go-live readiness for ENGIE France’s migration onto Kaluza as the hands-on lead, from planning through cutover, hypercare and transition towards scaling, so ENGIE’s teams are ready and confident to adopt the platform from day one.

  • Decide the change approach for the programme: stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, training design and business readiness engagement, shaped to ENGIE France’s operating context and owned by their teams.

  • Operate Kaluza’s business readiness governance: stage gates, readiness evidence, risk and dependency tracking and weekly reporting.

  • Partner with the Learning and Adoption Specialist in France to coordinate training, Train the Trainer and knowledge content, so enablement lands throughout each programme increment as we build out and release features via Agile delivery.

  • Be the day-to-day point of contact for ENGIE France on business readiness, change and adoption, giving practical change advice to their transformation leads.

  • Track adoption and operational stability through hypercare, root-cause any shortfall against acceptance criteria, and agree interventions with ENGIE.

  • Improve Kaluza’s readiness playbook: evolve what worked on ENGIE Belgium, test fixes where it falls short in France, and share what you learn with colleagues across Client Delivery to shape the platform’s operational foundations and improvements and to set our global standards.

Day to day, the activities you’ll lead or support include:

  • Change impact and readiness planning: diagnosing the full scope of impacts across roles, workflows, systems and customer experience, then turning them into a prioritised readiness plan sequenced against delivery, migration and release cadence.

  • Stakeholders, sponsors and change networks: mapping stakeholders and influence at workstream level, helping sponsors stay visible and engaged, and shaping the champion, superuser and people-manager networks that carry change into ENGIE’s business.

  • Communications and resistance: supporting ENGIE France’s own communications and engagement strategy, so their teams and customers hear a consistent, positive story about the programme. You’ll help leaders and champions advocate for the change, internally and with customers, and anticipate where resistance may form so you can intervene before it becomes entrenched.

  • Migration and go-live readiness: building the business and operational readiness evidence that enables a smooth transfer to service, measured against the agreed acceptance criteria, and supporting the go-live command centre.

  • Hypercare and stabilisation: agreeing hypercare entry and exit criteria, monitoring stability and adoption signals, and handing over cleanly to ENGIE’s business-as-usual teams.

  • Early releases and workarounds: planning for known limitations in early releases, and reflecting them in training, knowledge and communications so users are never caught by surprise. You’ll work with Release Management so each platform release arrives with the enablement it needs.

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Several years of hands-on change delivery on large platform or systems transformations, with a recognised change management discipline. You solve a wide range of problems creatively and work with little supervision.

  • Experience in regulated, customer-facing operational environments, including live customer account migration, cutover and go-live, where you have shaped the approach rather than only followed one.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management, credible with client programme leads and transformation sponsors.

  • Fluency in French and English, written and spoken.

  • Comfort working with data: you explore adoption and programme data yourself, report on it clearly and challenge decisions when evidence is weak.

  • Commercial awareness: you understand how Kaluza makes money and balance what the client needs against cost, working alongside SI partners and the client’s own change resources without duplicating effort.

What will set you apart: a background in energy retail or utilities, vendor-side experience on a SaaS implementation, and/or knowledge of contact centre operations and technology.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

Au quotidien, vous piloterez ou soutiendrez notamment les activités suivantes :

  • Impacts du changement et planification de la préparation : diagnostiquer l’ensemble des impacts sur les rôles, les processus, les systèmes et l’expérience client, puis les traduire en un plan de préparation priorisé, séquencé en fonction du rythme de livraison, de migration et de mise en production.

jobs.title: Finance Business Partner
jobs.description:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About the Role

This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do

Own the numbers

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

• 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering.

• Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists.

• Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity.

• Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO.

• Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies.

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

What We Offer

• Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus.

• Remote flexibility.

• A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust.

• Access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem - accelerate your personal and professional growth.

• Regular team events and company celebrations.

Interview Process

Here's what to expect and who you'll meet during the recruitment process:

• First interview with Talent Acquisition Manager (0.5 h)

• Second interview with Hiring Manager (1.0 h)

• Third interview with Group Finance representatives (1.0 h)

Any hiring decision is made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Position Overview

jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Healthcare Sites Development Manager

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us — We're obsessed with helping our members live healthier

  • Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

  • Member & customer-led: obsessively focused on solving members & customers problems and creating the most delightful experiences.

🏆 How we build excellence — We hire the best people and give them platform to succeed

  • Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density.

  • Distributed ownership: accountable enlightened despots, everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radically transparent: all information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

🤝 How we grow together — We help each other improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

  • Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care and support teammates.

  • Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally.

  • Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches.

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

  • Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time.

  • Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality.

💡 The Missions

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in Île-de-France, built to rethink occupational health with Alan's technology, for the benefit of employees and of healthcare professionals (HPs).

Its first medical centre opened at Valmy (Paris 10th) in April 2026, and 4 sites are already running.

Prévenir is about to scale fast: the ambition is to open several new small centres around Paris in 2027 (Seine-et-Marne, Val-d'Oise), first inside ready-to-operate sites, then in premises of its own (rented or bought), including a flagship centre in Paris. The exact plan is still being shaped, and you will help shape it.

We are looking for someone senior and visionary enough to carry the vision and strategy of Prévenir's sites from day one, while being happy (and excited) to be hands-on as much as needed, with a start-up mindset. Health, member experience and innovation are at the heart of the role.

You would join Alan as a full-time Alaner in the Workplace team: you work for Alan, not only for Prévenir. At first, most of your time goes to Prévenir: opening new sites, making them compliant and ready for patients with a real Prevenir's spirit, running the centres day to day with the center managers, and building the vendors, budgets and playbook that will let it grow from 4 to many more sites.

Prévenir is a separate entity from Alan: it signs its own leases and contracts, and you prepare, negotiate and advise on its behalf.

You will work alongside the Facility Manager in charge of Alan's offices at Valmy, and turn what you learn into playbooks, checklists and templates (openings, fit-out, vendors, compliance) that serve Prévenir's centres as much as Alan's own offices.

The position is based in Paris, with regular field visits across Île-de-France (Paris, Seine-et-Marne, Hauts-de-Seine, Val-d'Oise), and requires an onsite or field presence at least 4 days per week.

👀 More specificities on the profile we're looking for (level range targeted on our level grid: C1-D)

Detailed missions

Set the vision

  • Define and carry the vision and strategy for Prévenir's sites from day one: site model, technical and experience standards, and a 2–3 year real-estate roadmap, alongship Prévenir's and Alan's leadership and kept up to date as the plan evolves

  • Bring innovation: test new centre formats (shared, modular or temporary sites), and have a smart use of AI to make each opening faster, cheaper and better for HPs and patients

Open and build new sites

  • Find and technically qualify new sites: define search criteria with the Occupational Health team, visit candidate sites, and give a clear go / no-go recommendation with an estimated cost

  • Open small centres inside ready-to-operate sites: check that the host site works for medical use, agree the terms with the host operator (services, charges, service levels, who does what), do the light set-up and prepare the opening

  • Prepare and negotiate leases with Legal and Finance, and be the single operational point of contact for landlords, architects and vendors

  • When relevant, lead fit-out works end to end: brief and manage architects, project managers and contractors, plan backwards from the opening date, secure administrative and safety authorisations, manage acceptance and close snags

  • Contribute to the rent vs buy thinking by providing technical due diligence on any potential acquisition (condition of the building, works to expect, regulatory constraints, running costs)

Make every centre medical-ready, unique, safe and healthy

  • Make every site ready for patients: consultation rooms, patient flows, confidentiality (acoustics), hygiene and cleaning, medical waste, hand-washing points, IT / network and badge access set up with the IT team

  • Own the safety and security of every centre, for patients, HPs and visitors: access control, intrusion alarms and video surveillance where relevant (in line with GDPR), fire safety, evacuation procedures and drills, first-aid kits and defibrillators where required, and clear procedures for incidents and for HPs working alone

  • Put prevention at the heart of the run: identify the main risk areas of each centre (fire safety, HVAC and air quality, water, electrical, access control), build and run the preventive maintenance calendar, plan the mandatory periodic checks and keep each site's safety register up to date

Run the centres day to day

  • Run the day-to-day for existing and new centres with the center managers (ASSTs): sort and diagnose requests, fix what can be fixed, send the rest to the right contractor, and follow each intervention until it is done and checked

  • Own the logistical run of the centres in partnership with the center managers: supplies, snacks, mail, printing, small furniture and IT equipment, access and badges, cleaning. Agree a clear split of who does what and give them simple routines, checklists and documentation so they become autonomous

  • Create and keep alive the Prévenir spirit in every centre, as the Workplace team does for Alan its own offices: a welcoming, consistent and on-brand place for HPs, ASSTs and patients, using their feedback to keep improving it

Manage vendors, budgets and playbooks

  • Build a standard vendor panel (maintenance, fire safety, cleaning, medical waste, access control, furniture) with SLAs, penalties and exit terms. Run tenders and invoice checks, and reuse contracts across sites

  • Own the budget with Finance and the Occupational Health team: capex (fit-out, equipment, furniture) and opex (rent, charges, maintenance) per site, monthly follow-up, and realistic figures to feed the medical centres business model

  • Track, improve and document: run a simple dashboard (open requests, intervention times, openings progress, budget), keep the equipment inventory and maintenance log, automate repetitive follow-ups with AI and tools, and write the opening playbook and technical checklist reused for each new site

Be a full member of the Workplace team

  • Take part in the team's rituals and priorities, work with Alan's Workplace scope and join the on-call rotation (daily Office Management tasks)

Key outcomes by 1 year

  • A vision and a 2–3 year real-estate roadmap for Prévenir's sites are shared and approved by Prévenir's leadership and Alan within the first 3 months, and kept up to date

  • Existing centres are under control: contracts, leases, mandatory checks, equipment, open requests and risks are mapped and documented, with no missed regulatory check or expired contract

  • Preventive maintenance plans and safety registers are live on every centre, with at least 3 prevention areas identified, each with an action plan and KPIs

  • One single channel logs and tracks requests from the centres, each with an owner and a deadline; resolution time is measured and decreasing; a dashboard tracks requests, openings and budget; at least 3 recurring tasks are automated

  • The new centres planned for 2027 open on time, with safety, accessibility and authorisations validated before the first patient and a budget under control

  • A replicable opening playbook, a building technical checklist, a standard vendor panel and standard contract templates are in place and reused across sites

  • Every centre feels like Prévenir, is safe and secure (access control, alarms and emergency procedures in place and tested, drills done on time), and is healthy.

  • At least one innovation (new centre format, building tech or AI use case) has been tested in a centre, with clear results on cost, speed or HP and patient experience

You may be a great fit if you are:

  • A multi-site Facility / Technical Manager (6–10 years of experience) in a network of regulated, public-access sites: clinics, medical or radiology centres, labs, dental or health-centre networks, nurseries, fitness, retail networks

  • A real-estate project manager in charge of network expansion and site openings, with a real sensitivity to the run

  • A head of technical services of a clinic or private hospital who wants to move to a growth environment

  • A works / fit-out project manager (chef de projet travaux, maîtrise d'ouvrage) with strong ERP experience and some maintenance and run exposure

  • A site or contract manager at an FM service provider (healthcare accounts) who wants to move in-house, or a Workplace / Facility Manager in a scale-up who has led several office openings or moves

What we're looking for

  • Solid technical understanding of buildings: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety systems, doors and access control, and the ability to challenge a technician or an architect

  • Proven experience of opening or fitting out sites: works follow-up with architects, project managers and contractors, planning, acceptance, snags

  • Knowledge of the French regulatory framework for public-access buildings (ERP classification, safety commission, works authorisation, accessibility, mandatory periodic checks, safety register)

  • Good knowledge of site safety and security: access control, intrusion alarms, video surveillance (and related GDPR rules), evacuation and emergency procedures, incident management

  • Lease and landlord management: you can read a lease, understand who pays and does what, and negotiate with landlords and agents

  • Proven vendor and contract management (SLAs, penalties, price indexation, tenders, invoice control) and budget ownership (capex / opex per site, total cost of ownership)

  • Project management of several sites in parallel, with strong prioritisation, including urgent incidents

  • Ability to work with senior and varied stakeholders: HPs and doctors, directors, Legal, Finance, IT, landlords, architects

  • Senior enough to set a vision and a strategy, and to carry and defend it with Prévenir's leadership and Alan, with a start-up mindset: frugal, fast, comfortable building from scratch with changing priorities, and happy to be hands-on

  • Exceptional communication in French (fluent) and professional English

  • A member-first mindset: you think about the HP, patient and Alaner experience, not the process

  • Appetite for digital tools, AI and basic automation to reduce repetitive work, and the ability to document in a way the whole team and AI agents can leverage

  • Mobility across Île-de-France (Paris, 77, 92, 95 and more)

  • Visionary and hands-on, autonomous and proactive, at ease with ambiguity while the plan (number of sites, rent vs buy, timing) is still evolving, calm when things don't go as planned, and discreet and respectful of the medical environment

Nice to have

  • Experience of medical, paramedical or health-related sites (centres de santé, clinics, labs), including ERP type U requirements

  • A technical diploma or certification (BTS / DUT in building maintenance or energy, SSIAP) and electrical habilitation

  • Experience of a technical due diligence on a building purchase, or of a sale-and-leaseback / long-lease structure

  • Experience with indoor air quality or energy-efficiency projects

  • Experience using a CMMS / GMAO tool, or building one with no-code tools

  • Extensive experience leveraging AI to build scalable processes or automate recurring tasks

  • Prior experience in a high-growth company or scale-up, ideally in a network-expansion context

 

🙌 Perks & Benefits


At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

jobs.description:
𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘆

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Many management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds, yet they struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren’t built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so our clients can launch and run ETFs at scale, helping broaden the access to the market beyond a small group of dominant, US-based providers.

You will own end-to-end responsibility for the ETFs we run: smooth product launches, day-to-day execution and oversight, as well as continuous platform evolution in collaboration with our product team. This is a strongly hands-on role combining investment expertise, market microstructure understanding, operational excellence and cross-functional execution.

You will have the opportunity to gradually expand your scope into platform building, process scaling, new strategic projects and service development.

  • Manage creation/redemptions and associated cash flows; oversee daily ETF operations from a portfolio perspective

  • Support larger secondary market transactions, produce/interpret trade reporting and support ETF launches

Portfolio Management

  • Take investment ownership for assigned ETFs, actively optimizing portfolio construction, risk and execution to enhance tracking and liquidity

  • Execute portfolio replication and rebalancing

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

We are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's AI Neobank and financial products.

Job Summary

The Senior Research Scientist sits on DeepHealth's ML Capabilities team and advances research in machine learning for medical imaging, with a focus on foundation models in radiology AI. This role designs novel model architectures, develops experimental systems to test research hypotheses, and helps translate research into solutions that support clinical applications. The work draws on DeepHealth's large-scale imaging data and expert feedback loops and includes collaboration with research partners such as Imperial College London.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Define and drive the scientific roadmap for foundation models in medical imaging within the ML Capabilities programme.

  • Track and evaluate developments in machine learning and generative AI relevant to radiology and multimodal imaging.

  • Design and prototype novel model architectures for multimodal medical imaging data.

  • Develop experimental systems to validate research hypotheses and measure progress against scientific goals.

  • Establish and maintain benchmarking frameworks across downstream clinical and technical tasks.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to translate research advances into deployable solutions.

  • Lead scientific publications and conference contributions that communicate DeepHealth research results.

  • Engage with external research collaborators, including partners at Imperial College London.

  • Mentor researchers and contribute to research quality standards within the ML Capabilities team.

  • Document methods, experiments, and findings to support reproducibility, review, and knowledge transfer.

 

 PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above.  Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field (required).

  • Expertise in deep learning and generative models (required).

  • Experience designing and evaluating machine learning systems (required).

  • Preferred: Experience in medical imaging or healthcare AI.

  • Preferred: Familiarity with multimodal learning.

  • Preferred: Experience mentoring or leading research projects.

Quality Standards

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Vous avez managé et développé une organisation d'au moins 10 personnes, idéalement composée de profils hétérogènes, avec un historique de transformation, de montée en séniorité et de développement de managers.

  • Vous savez délivrer des résultats à court terme tout en construisant le segment à moyen et long terme, avec rigueur analytique, gravitas C-level et excellente coordination transverse avec Tech, Déploiement, Legal, Finance, Product Marketing, Affaires Publiques et Partenariats.

  • Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

  • Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python.

jobs.description:
About the role:

As a Senior Systems Engineer – Industrialization, you will play a key role in bringing our next-generation unmanned systems from development and prototyping into stable, scalable production.

You will take technical ownership at the intersection of Systems Engineering, R&D, Production and Industrialization. Rather than leading a team from a disciplinary perspective, you will act as a senior technical expert and sparring partner, helping establish robust processes, solve complex system-level issues and continuously improve the maturity of our products and production environment.

The role offers a high degree of ownership in an environment where structures and processes are still evolving and where your expertise can have a direct impact on how we industrialize our systems.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Drive the industrialization of complex unmanned systems from prototype and development stages toward stable serial production.

  • Take technical ownership of system-level topics throughout the industrialization lifecycle.

  • Analyze and resolve complex technical issues arising during production, integration, testing and operation.

  • Identify whether technical issues originate from product design, system integration, manufacturing processes or individual components and drive them toward sustainable resolution.

  • Define and continuously improve technical processes, standards and methodologies for industrialization and system integration.

  • Work closely with Systems Engineering, R&D, Production, Quality, Testing and Supply Chain to ensure product and production readiness.

  • Translate lessons learned from production and field feedback into concrete technical improvements.

  • Support root cause analysis and structured problem solving for recurring or critical system-level issues.

  • Ensure that system requirements, interfaces and technical dependencies are understood and adequately reflected in the production environment.

  • Act as a senior technical sparring partner for engineers and stakeholders across different disciplines.

  • Mentor colleagues through your technical expertise and help establish best practices without formal disciplinary leadership responsibility.

  • Contribute to building scalable structures as products and production volumes continue to grow.



What you bring to the team:

  • A degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a comparable technical field.

  • Several years of professional experience in Systems Engineering, Industrialization, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Engineering or a comparable technical role.

  • Strong experience working with complex multidisciplinary products, ideally involving hardware, electronics, embedded software and mechanical systems.

  • Proven experience supporting products during the transition from prototype or development into serial production.

  • Strong understanding of system architecture, interfaces, requirements and verification principles.

  • Practical experience with structured problem-solving and root-cause-analysis methods, for example 8D, FMEA, Ishikawa or 5-Why.

  • Ability to identify dependencies across engineering disciplines and translate complex technical problems into actionable solutions.

  • Experience working closely with production and engineering teams in a fast-moving development environment.

  • A pragmatic and hands-on mindset with a strong sense of technical ownership.

Business Line Manager - Money Flows
jobs.description:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team:

With over 8 million signers sold worldwide, Ledger Wallet is where Ledger users manage and grow their assets. Transactional Services (buy, sell, swap, trading and stablecoin products) is its main source of service revenue.

Money Flows connects users' crypto to the fiat world in both directions: on/off-ramp, cash-to-stablecoin, Card, and the growing P2P and Payments use cases. Users buy crypto with fiat or sell it back to their bank, move cash into stablecoins, and spend crypto with a card, all through specialist partners. It is the entry and exit door of the Ledger Wallet economy and a key lever to diversify Transactional Services revenue. The role reports to the Senior Director, Transactional Services.

What you’ll be doing:

You own and grow Money Flows end to end - revenue, economics, partner ecosystem and the quality of every fiat journey in Ledger Wallet - with a General Manager mindset over a business run mostly through external partners and cross-functional teams. The ambition is to grow revenue 10x in two to three years, through a strategy and roadmap you define and turn into quantified milestones.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Business Line Ownership & Revenue Delivery: Being ultimately accountable for Money Flows revenue, volume and take rate across buy, sell, cash-to-stablecoin, Card, P2P and Payments. Building and defending the forecast, querying the data yourself, and separating market effects from the levers the team controls.

  • Monetization & Pricing: Owning take rate by line, partner and payment method. Turning volume into direct or indirect revenue (zero-fee partners, cash-to-stablecoin flows), and keeping pricing/product competitive against exchanges, neobanks and other wallets.

  • Partner Management & Business Development: Identifying, signing, managing and negotiating with the ramp, payment, stablecoin and card-issuing partner bench - on pricing, geographic and payment-method coverage, conversion, KYC friction and operational quality. Managing concentration risk, onboarding new providers to close gaps, and running a monthly review with each partner.

  • Card Programme Ownership: Running the card programme: economics, activation and dormancy, issuer and processor performance, card-scheme negotiations (including geo expansion), and the go-to-market with Marketing.

  • Ledger Wallet Experience: Working with the Product Line Manager to improve the Buy, Sell, Card and Pay journeys, and making sure every release ships with a coordinated go-to-market.

  • Stablecoin & Payments Roadmap: Shaping how Ledger captures stablecoin and payment use cases - cash-to-stablecoin, Pay and peer-to-peer flows - together with Product, within local regulatory frameworks (MiCA,...) with Legal and Compliance, informed by close tracking of the ramp, stablecoin and card landscape.

  • Operational Excellence & Observability: Partner SLAs, incident management and fast action to protect users, Ledger and revenue; conversion, failed-payment and KYC-drop monitoring; and closing measurement gaps so every line can be steered on data.

  • Cross-Functional Delivery: Driving execution across Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Pricing, Marketing/CRM and other business lines - all of it outside your reporting lines - to ship improvements, drive growth and resolve issues.

What we’re looking for:

  • Ownership mindset: A demonstrated ability to own a business line or revenue stream end to end and make data-driven decisions. You are energized by being accountable for a P&L line and delivering the budget, including in a soft market.

  • Exceptional quantitative skills: A strong track record of using data to drive decisions and manage execution. You enjoy digging into the numbers yourself and separating market effect from execution.

  • Commercial & business development experience: Proven results negotiating and managing external partners on pricing, terms and performance. You like using data and leverage to improve terms, coverage and quality, and building relationships that compound over time. Sales / business development experience is highly valued.

  • Payments industry experience (required): Experience in payments (for example at Visa, Adyen, Stripe or dLocal), with hands-on knowledge of payments and acquiring - conversion funnels, KYC, fraud and chargeback dynamics.

  • Card ecosystem: Experience in the card ecosystem - issuing, processing, card schemes or programme management, including interchange and programme economics - is a strong plus.

  • Operational excellence: Evidence of running something with rigor - managing operational risk, reducing errors and optimizing conversion or engagement. You are comfortable running live lines while shaping new ones, such as stablecoins, payments and card programs.

  • Influence in a matrixed organization: The proven ability to align Product, Tech, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Marketing behind your priorities and drive cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.

  • Consumer fintech / service-revenue background: Experience in a high-volume transactional or service-revenue business is highly desirable; a B2C background is a strong plus. Fintech or equivalent service experience is a must.

  • Digital assets: Interest in stablecoins and crypto is desirable, as the crypto knowledge needed can be learned faster than payments expertise. Familiarity with MiCA and European payments regulation is a plus.

  • AI: Strong appetite for what AI can bring to analysis and operations is a must.

  • Total English fluency. The role is based in Paris; French is not a prerequisite for social or work life in our office.

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.
